actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 1 piercing damage.

features.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
features.description: The Hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) ability checks that rely on hearing and smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 2 piercing damage.

features.name: Focused
features.description: Ruby’s use of the staff in combat is unmatched. She may use her Dexterity modifier instead of her Strength to determine to-hit and damage. She has 3 Focus points, which she regains when she takes a short or long rest. She can use her bonus action and spend one Focus point on her turn to take the Dash, Disengage or Dodge action or to make another attack with her Staff.

features.name: Well-travelled
features.description: If Ruby is with the Company and they are travelling in the Bree-land then the Guide rolls 1d8+4 for the Embarkation Roll.

actions.name: Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage or 6 (1d8+2) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

features.name: Battle-wise
features.description: Hallas has Advantage on initiative checks.

features.name: Endurance of the Dúnedain
features.description: Hallas may continue to act normally for one round after being reduced to 0 hit points.

features.name: Long-pipe
features.description: Hallas can make a DC 15 Intelligence (Pipe) check as an action. On a success, he makes his next ability check with Advantage.

features.name: Unyielding (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Hallas can use his bonus action to gain 10 temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hallas can make two attacks with his Long Sword or Short Bow.

actions.name: Long Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10+3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Short Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft, one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

features.name: Bolster
features.description: If Matthew is present for an Audience, his support can sway others. The spokesperson for the Company can make a DC 15 Persuasion (Charisma) check with Disadvantage to impress him, on a success the Company has Advantage on all other checks during the Audience.

features.name: Confound
features.description: If Matthew is present for an Audience, he can bluster a storm of opinions that can turn the tide against outsiders. The spokesperson for the Company must make a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or gain Disadvantage on all further checks during the Audience.

actions.name: Hazel Rod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Defender of That Which He Loves
features.description: If Tad is fighting in defense of Bree, he can use his bonus action to gain 10 temporary hit points.

features.name: Shield-strike
features.description: If Tad has just struck with his club, he can use his bonus action to slam his shield into his target. The creature takes 2 points of bludgeoning damage and must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw or become Prone.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Cruel Stroke
features.description: If Anna's attack has just hit, she may spend her bonus action to turn her attack into a critical hit.

features.name: Distraction Attack
features.description: Anna can use her bonus action to feint or otherwise distract her opponent. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or she gains Advantage on her attacks this round.

features.name: Wicked Cunning
features.description: Anna can use her bonus action to activate this ability. For the remainder of the combat, she has +4 to her AC.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: She makes three melee attacks with her Dagger.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.description: If Anna can see an attacker that has struck her, she may use her reaction to halve that attack's damage.

features.name: Expert
features.description: Jack doubles his Proficiency Bonus for Deception and Perception (included above).

features.name: Nimble Escape
features.description: Jack can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, Jack deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has Advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of his ally that isn’t Incapacitated and he doesn’t have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Short Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Short Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Jack adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

features.name: Expert
features.description: Grandmother Tunnelly doubles her Proficiency Bonus for Intimidation and Traditions (included above).

features.name: Lord of Her Domain
features.description: Grandmother Tunnelly only meets with visitors in the ancient and richly decorated halls of the Great Smial. She imposes Disadvantage on the Introduction Check for an Audience.

features.name: Stubborn Will
features.description: If a speaker in an Audience with Grandmother Tunnelly wishes to propose a course of action adverse to her wishes, the speaker must first make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw.

actions.name: Umbrella
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Duellist
features.description: Oswald is more skilled with a sword than most Bree-folk know, add +2 to his damage (included below).

features.name: Unyielding (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Oscar can use his bonus action to gain 6 temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Oscar makes two melee attacks with his Long Sword.

actions.name: Long Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) slashing damage or 10 (1d10+5) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

reactions.name: Great Might (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: Oscar can use his reaction when struck to reduce the damage he takes by 3, to a minimum of 1.

features.name: Battle-wise
features.description: Harry has Advantage on initiative checks.

features.name: Savage Assault
features.description: When Harry rolls a natural 18 or 19 on his attack roll, he may use his bonus action to make a single additional melee attack against the same opponent.

features.name: Warrior's Charge
features.description: Harry gains Advantage on all attacks made in the first round of combat.

actions.name: Great Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) slashing damage.

features.name: Expert
features.description: Butterbur doubles his Proficiency Bonus for both Insight and Perception (included above).

features.name: Friendly and Inquisitive
features.description: Butterbur doubles his Proficiency Bonus for Traditions (included above) and counts as Friendly during any Audience.

features.name: Storehouse of Knowledge
features.description: Butterbur knows much about the Bree-land. A hero that spends a short rest talking to him can automatically begin a journey that starts from Bree on Paths Both Swift and True.

actions.name: Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) bludgeoning damage or 5 (1d8+1) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

features.name: Glamour
features.description: An Oakman can choose to appear more Hobbitish, though in this form they still appear unkempt and uncivilised. This illusion can be dispelled as a bonus action, and is automatically dispelled when the Oakman attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Oakman makes two attacks with either its Short Sword or its Bow.

actions.name: Short Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Short Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Ill-turn of Luck (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: Strange fates befall those who attack the Oakmen. If an attack roll misses the Oakman, it may use this ability: the attacking creature must make another attack roll against its own AC. On a success, it does damage to itself.

features.name: Corpse Light (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: A Swamp Goblin can use its bonus action to cause a light to appear anywhere within 60 feet of it. Any hostile creature who is not Blinded must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature must use its movement to approach the light, repeating the save at the end of its turn.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, the Swamp Goblin deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has Advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the Goblin that isn’t Incapacitated and the Goblin doesn’t have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Stealthy
features.description: The Swamp Goblin may use its bonus action each round to Hide.

actions.name: Jagged Knife
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d4+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bow of Horn
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage. The victim must also make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

features.name: Argumentative
features.description: A Two-headed Troll is prone to getting into fights with itself. A creature can make a DC 13 Intelligence (Riddle) or Charisma (Persuasion) check to distract the Troll. On a success, the Troll must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw at the start of its next turn or spend its turn arguing with itself. If the Troll is injured, it has Advantage on this saving throw.

features.name: Horrible Strength
features.description: If the Two-headed Troll makes a successful melee attack, it may use its bonus action to cause 8 additional damage of the same type to the target.

features.name: Two-headed
features.description: Trolls with two heads are much harder to catch unawares. Any attempts at Stealth are made with Disadvantage and the Troll gains Advantage on both active and passive Perception checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Troll makes two attacks with its club.

actions.name: Troll-club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 21 (2d12+8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

features.name: Craven
features.description: If the White Wolf starts its turn with 31 or less hit points, it must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it becomes Frightened and must use its Dash or Disengage action to move away from any enemies. If movement is impossible, it will take the Dodge action instead.

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: The White Wolf is fearful of fire. If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of it, the wolf suffers Disadvantage on its attack rolls. In addition, the White Wolf is not able to use its Pack Tactics ability.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The White Wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the White Wolf’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The White Wolf makes two attacks: one bite and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 10 (1d12+4) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Commanding Voice
reactions.description: The White Wolf can snarl in the language of its kind to issue commands. It may use its reaction when a non-hostile creature, that it can see within 30 feet, is about to make an attack roll or a saving throw. The target can add a d6 Command Die to that roll, provided it can hear and understand the message. A creature can benefit from only one Command Die at a time, and creatures that possess Commanding Voice cannot benefit from this effect.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The Ogre can hold its breath for such long periods that it is effectively a water-breather in combat situations.

features.name: Rubbery Skin
features.description: This creature’s rubbery flesh is immune to bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Swimmer
features.description: This creature can move through aquatic environments without penalty.

actions.name: Grasp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one Medium or smaller target. Hit: The target becomes grappled (escape DC 17). As a bonus action, the Ogre may inflict 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage on the grappled creature.

actions.name: Shield Smasher (Recharge after a short or long rest)
actions.description: To destroy a shield, the Ogre makes a Slam attack, concentrating all its damage on the shield itself. If the Ogre deals 20 or more damage, the targeted shield is destroyed and worthless. A legendary shield might be salvageable but cannot be used for the remainder of the combat.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Great Might (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: The Ogre may use its reaction when it takes damage from a melee or ranged weapon attack: the damage amount is reduced by 5, to a minimum of 1 point of damage taken.

features.name: Great Leap
features.description: The Old Troll is capable of jumping huge distances. He may make a special Dash action to go twice his normal movement in a single jump. Any opponents in melee combat with the Old Troll when he uses this ability get Opportunity Attacks as normal.

features.name: Reckless
features.description: The Old Troll may use his bonus action to gain Advantage on attack rolls until the start of his next turn but all attacks on him also have Advantage.

features.name: Sunlight Curse
features.description: Stone-trolls become Petrified and turn into stone if they are touched by the bright light of the sun. Once the sun rises, the Old Troll must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw at the beginning of his turn in order to find enough cover to avoid being turned to stone. On a failure, the Old Troll becomes Petrified.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Old Troll makes two attacks: one with his troll-knife and one slam.

actions.name: Troll-knife
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Deadly Misfortune (Lair Only, Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: Trolls don’t usually know any magic, but the Old Troll remembers a few tricks he learned in ancient Angmar. If a character attacks the Troll and misses, he may cause one of his piles of bones to suddenly slip and collapse on top of the character, crashing and clattering very loudly. The target must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone. The area within 10 feet of the target is now difficult terrain and the target makes all attack rolls at Disadvantage until it is outside the area of effect.

features.name: Bulky Armour
features.description: The Brigand has Disadvantage on Dexterity checks

actions.name: Battle Cry (1/day)
actions.description: The Brigand may use its action to activate this ability. Each Brigand within 30 feet of it gains Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the Brigand’s next turn. The Brigand may then make one attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Brigand makes two attacks with its axe.

actions.name: Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage.

features.name: Expert
features.description: The Mountebank doubles its Proficiency Bonus for Deception and Sleight of Hand (included above).

features.name: Nimble Escape
features.description: The Mountebank can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Mountebank makes two dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Prestidigitation
actions.description: As long as the Mountebank has had time to prepare the area, it may spend its action to activate a series of distracting effects — clouds of smoke, loud noises, strange clatterings, objects moving seemingly of their own accord or the like. Each enemy within 60 feet of the Mountebank must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become Stunned until the beginning of the Mountebank’s next turn. The Mountebank can then use its bonus action to make a single Dagger attack.

actions.name: Voice of Command (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A Mountebank can bring all of its considerable force of personality to bear on a single creature. Its voice booms with authority or softly suggests wiser courses of action. The creature must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or become Charmed by the Mountebank for 1 minute. The creature will not attack its allies and realises that the Mountebank affected it only after the effect expires.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.description: If the Mountebank can see an attacker that has struck it, it may use its reaction to halve that attack’s damage.

features.name: Reckless
features.description: Tomas may use his bonus action to gain Advantage on attack rolls until the start of his next turn but all attacks on him also have Advantage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

features.name: Leadership
features.description: As a bonus action, Edoric can command a nearby ally that has not yet acted this round. That creature takes its turn immediately after Edoric.

features.name: Unyielding (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Edoric can use his bonus action to gain 6 temporary hit points.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage or 8 (1d8+4) if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Defend Ally (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: If an ally is within 5 feet of Edoric, he may use his reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll against that ally.

features.name: Berserk Rage
features.description: Whenever Vogar takes damage, he must make a Wisdom saving throw against DC 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher. On a failure he flies into a berserk rage. He gains Advantage on his attack rolls, Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws and all attacks against him are at Advantage. At the start of his turn if there are no enemies within his movement, he must make another saving throw (with Disadvantage) to end this effect. On a failure, he attacks an ally within range.

features.name: Horrible Strength
features.description: If Vogar makes a successful melee attack, he may use his bonus action to cause 4 additional of the same type to the target.

actions.name: Mattock
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

features.name: Reckless
features.description: The young Dwarf may choose to gain Advantage on all attacks he makes in a round, but all attacks on him gain Advantage until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Broad Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage.

features.name: Cold be Hand and Heart
features.description: If Berelas has just successfully made a melee attack, she can use her bonus action to channel some of the Cold Shade's power. The target takes 1d8 necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the start of her next turn.

features.name: Shade-caller
features.description: As a bonus action, Berelas can summon the Cold Shade. It arrives at the end of her next turn.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d4+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: The Cold Shade is repulsed by the heat of fire. If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of it, it suffers Disadvantage on its attack rolls.

features.name: Ghost-form
features.description: The Cold Shade is insubstantial and cannot be easily hurt by normal means. See the damage and condition resistances and immunities above.

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.description: The Cold Shade can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

features.name: Thing of Terror (1/day, at night only)
features.description: The Cold Shade can use its bonus action to bring a cold chill to the heart of any hero. Any companion within 60 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened of the ghost. At the end of the creature's turn it may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Icy Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) necrotic damage and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Paralysed by the cold. A target can repeat the save at the end of its turn to end the effect.

actions.name: Bewilder (1/day)
actions.description: Gorlanc still has enough magic to temporarily distract his foes. He can use his action to make all creatures within 30 feet make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become Stunned for 1d4+1 rounds. While the effect lasts, he may use his bonus action to make a melee attack against a Stunned creature.

actions.name: Enervation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Gorlanc points at a creature and snarls in a dark tongue some sorcerous malediction. The target must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is weakened: it may only move or take an action (not both) on its turn and has Disadvantage on attack rolls. And the end of its turn, the target may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Poisoned Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned until they take a long rest.

features.name: Charge
features.description: If the aatxe moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

features.name: Know Thoughts
features.description: The aatxe can use an action to read the surface thoughts of one creature within 30 feet. This works like the detect thoughts spell, except it can only read surface thoughts and there is no limit to the duration. It can end this effect as a bonus action or by using an action to change the target.

features.name: Limited Speech (Humanoid Form Only)
features.description: The aatxe can verbally communicate only simple ideas and phrases, though it can understand and follow a conversation without issue.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The aatxe has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The aatxe can use its action to polymorph into a Medium male humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Paw the Earth
actions.description: The aatxe lowers its horns and paws at the ground with its hooves. Each creature within 30 feet of the aatxe must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the aatxe’s Paw the Earth for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.description: The aatxe makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Gore (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The aatxe makes one gore attack.

legendary_actions.name: Bulwark (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The aatxe flares crimson with celestial power, protecting those nearby. The next attack that would hit an ally within 5 feet of the aatxe hits the aatxe instead.

features.name: Explosive Death
features.description: When the ant is reduced to 0 hp, it explodes in a burst of acid. Each creature within 5 feet of the ant must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 5 (2d4) acid damage.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The ant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Acid Spit
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) acid damage and the target takes 1 acid damage at the start of its next turn unless the target immediately uses its reaction to wipe off the spit.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.

features.name: Body in Flames
features.description: A creature that touches the agnibarra or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage, and flammable objects within 5 feet of the agnibarra that aren’t being worn or carried ignite.

features.name: Illumination
features.description: The agnibarra sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Burning Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Spit Fire
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The ahuizotl can breathe air and water.

features.name: Spiky Coat
features.description: A creature that touches the ahuizotl or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ahuizotl can use its Tail Grab. It then makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claw.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Grab
actions.description:
The ahuizotl grabs a creature or item. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 14). The ahuizotl can then move up to its speed as a bonus action. The grappled creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pulled along 5 feet behind the ahuizotl. A creature being dragged by the ahuizotl makes attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws with disadvantage. 
	 If the target is an object or weapon being held by another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw, or the ahuizotl pulls the object away from the creature. After stealing an object or weapon, the ahuizotl can move up to its speed as a bonus action. The ahuizotl can only grapple one creature or hold one weapon or object at a time. If holding a weapon, it can use its Tail Grab action to make one attack with the weapon with no proficiency bonus

features.name: Clockwork Encasement
features.description:
The creature within the machine is a somewhat shapeless mass, both protected and given concrete manipulators by its armor. The clockwork armor has a variety of manipulators that the ahu-nixta can use to attack or to interact with objects outside of the armor. When the ahu-nixta is reduced to 0 hp, its clockwork armor breaks and the ahu-nixta exits it. Once out of its armor, the creature's pulpy mass no longer receives the benefits of the listed Damage or Condition Immunities, except for psychic and prone. 
	 Without its clockwork armor, the ahu-nixta has the following statistics:  AC 12, hp 37 (5d10 + 10), Strength 9 (-1), and all its modes of travel are reduced to 20 feet. In addition, it has no attack actions, though it can still cast its spells. The ahu‑nixta's body can form eyes, mouths, and grabbing appendages. Its grabbing appendages can pick up objects and manipulate them, but the appendages can't be used for combat. The ahu-nixta's extra appendages can open and close glass-covered viewing ports in the clockwork armor, requiring no action, so it can see and interact with objects outside the armor. 
	 The ahu-nixta can exit or enter its clockwork armor as a bonus action.

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: The clockwork armor of the ahu-nixta is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form, as is the creature that controls it as long as the ahu-nixta remains within the armor.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The ahu-nixta's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The ahu-nixta can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
At will: fear, fire bolt (2d10), telekinesis

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ahu-nixta makes three melee attacks. It can cast one at will spell in place of two melee attacks.

actions.name: Whirring Blades
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Pronged Scepter
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+ 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bashing Rod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: One with Wind
features.description: An alkonost is immune to the effects of magical and natural wind, including effects that would force it to move, impose disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, or force it to land when flying. In addition, its weapon attacks do an extra 2 (1d4) lightning damage if it is within 1 mile of a lightning storm.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Charged Melody (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The alkonost sings a beautiful melody. Each creature within 30 feet of it that can hear the melody must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or take 7 (2d6) lightning damage the next time it moves.

features.name: Plant Camouflage
features.description: The alliumite has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

features.name: Tearful Stench
features.description: Each creature other than an alliumite within 5 feet of the alliumite when it takes damage must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the Tearful Stench of all alliumites for 1 minute.

actions.name: Thorn Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Grass Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

features.name: Shadow Stealth
features.description: While in dim light or darkness, the alp can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The alp can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Tiny beast it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the alp has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The alp's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). The alp can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: invisibility (self only)
3/day each: silent image, sleep
1/day each: bestow curse, dream

actions.name: Sleeper's Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and, if the target was sleeping or unconscious before it was hit, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened and restrained for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the restrained condition on itself on a success. The creature must succeed on another saving throw on a following round to end the frightened condition.

features.name: Judging Aura
features.description: An undead creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ammut must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the ammut's Judging Aura for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The ammut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Prison Belly
features.description: The large belly of the ammut magically sustains the life of those trapped inside it. A creature caught in its belly doesn't need food, water, or air. The ammut can maintain one Medium or smaller creature this way as long as the ammut remains alive.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the ammut can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description:
The ammut makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the ammut. An ammut can only have one Medium or smaller creature swallowed at a time.
	 If the ammut takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the ammut must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the ammut. If the ammut dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Ghost Breath (1/Day)
actions.description: The ammut inhales the tortured spirits of undead within 30 feet. Each undead creature of CR 1 and lower in the area is automatically destroyed. All other undead must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Absorb Spirit (1/Day)
actions.description: The ammut attempts to absorb the spirit of a dead or undead creature in its belly. The creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be absorbed by the ammut. A creature absorbed this way is destroyed and can't be reanimated, though it can be restored to life by powerful magic, such as a resurrection spell. The ammut regains hp equal to the absorbed creature's hp maximum.

name: Eye of the Gods
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Blazing Nimbus
features.description: A hostile creature that touches the eye of the gods or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) radiant (good or neutral eyes) or necrotic (evil eyes) damage.

features.name: Corona of Truth
features.description: Allies within 10 feet of the eye of the gods have truesight of 20 feet.

features.name: Divine Conduit
features.description: The deity that created the eye of the gods can see everything the eye sees and can instantly recall the eye to its side at any time.

features.name: Ethereal Jaunt
features.description: As a bonus action, the eye of the gods can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) radiant (good or neutral eyes) or necrotic (evil eyes) damage.

actions.name: Divine Inspiration (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The eye of the gods inspires all allies within 10 feet. For 1 minute, all inspired creatures have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

name: Kinnara
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Angelic Weapons
features.description: The kinnara's weapon attacks are magical. When the kinnara hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

features.name: Eternal Lovers
features.description: The kinnara shares a powerful bond with its partner and can't be turned against its partner by magical or non-magical means.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The kinnara's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The kinnara can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect good and evil, guidance, light, spare the dying
3/day each: charm person, sleep, healing word
1/day each: calm emotions, enthrall, hold person

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Discordant Refrain (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The kinnara plays a series of jarring notes on its musical instrument. Each non-celestial creature within 60 feet who can hear the sound must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage but isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Share the Pain
reactions.description: When the kinnara's partner is hit with a melee or ranged attack, the kinnara can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of its partner. The damage caused by the attack is divided evenly between the two kinnara.

name: Ophanim
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Divine Awareness
features.description: The ophanim knows if it hears a lie.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The ophanim has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Immortal Nature
features.description: The ophanim angel doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The ophanim's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 21). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: bless, detect evil and good, invisibility (self only), scrying, thaumaturgy
3/day each: dispel evil and good, earthquake, holy aura
1/day each: commune, forbiddance, true resurrection

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ophanim makes four Light of Judgment attacks.

actions.name: Light of Judgment
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +13 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Holy Fire (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ophanim emits a burst of holy fire. Each creature within 30 feet of the ophanim must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A humanoid reduced to 0 hp by this damage dies, leaving only a pile of fine ash.

name: Sammael
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Angelic Weapons
features.description: The sammael's weapon attacks are magical. When the sammael hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

features.name: Sacred Duty
features.description:
The sammael angel can use its bonus action to shift its purpose between Destructor, Executioner, and Punisher.
•  Destructor. The sammael's purpose is to destroy unholy monuments and statues. Its weapon attacks deal double damage to objects and structures. 
•  Executioner. The sammael's purpose is to slay a specific creature. The angel has advantage on attack rolls against a specific creature, chosen by its deity. As long as the angel and the victim are on the same plane of existence, the angel knows the precise location of the creature.
•  Punisher. The sammael's purpose is to punish, but not kill, creatures, inflicting long-term suffering on those of its deity's choosing. A creature reduced to 0 hp by the angel loses 3 (1d6) Charisma as its body is horribly scarred by the deity's retribution. The scars last until the creature is cured by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

features.name: Immortal Nature
features.description: The sammael angel doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sammael makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe (Executioner Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Slam (Destructor Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the angel.

actions.name: Whip (Punisher Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. A creature's hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the radiant damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a short or long rest.

name: Song Angel
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Angelic Weapons
features.description: The song angel’s weapon attacks are magical. When the song angel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The angel’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: alter self, calm emotions, charm person, create food and water, detect evil and good  
3/day each: enthrall, silence, zone of truth
1/day each: irresistible dance, mass cure wounds

features.name: Immortal Nature
features.description: The song angel doesn’t require food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Horn of Blasting (Recharges 5–6)
actions.description: The song angel blows on its ram’s horn, emitting a thunderous blast in a 30-foot cone that is audible 600 feet away. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 17 (5d6) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage but isn’t deafened. Creatures and objects made of glass or crystal have disadvantage on the saving throw and take 35 (10d6) thunder damage instead.

actions.name: Horn of Spirits (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.description: The song angel blows on its brass horn, calling forth 10 (3d4 + 3) warrior spirits. These spirits appear within 60 feet of the angel and use tribal warrior statistics. When the spirits are summoned, one of them is always an ancient champion that uses berserker statistics. They disappear after 1 hour or when they are reduced to 0 hp. These spirits follow the angel’s commands.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.description:
The angel magically polymorphs into a humanoid that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the angel’s choice).
	 In the new form, the angel retains its game statistics and the ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

reactions.name: Heavenly Inspiration
reactions.description: When a creature the song angel can see fails an ability check or saving throw or misses with a weapon attack, the angel can sing a verse of divine music. If the creature hears this song, it can reroll the failed check, save, or attack roll with advantage.

name: Zoryas
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The angel's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: alter self, calm emotions, charm person, create food and water, detect evil and good
3/day each: enthrall, silence, zone of truth
1/day each: irresistible dance, mass cure wounds

features.name: Fire and Light
features.description: The zoryas' weapon attacks are magical. When the zoryas hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant or fire damage (included in the attack). The zoryas chooses whether its attack does radiant or fire damage before making the attack roll.

features.name: Open Celestial Gate
features.description: As an action, the zoryas opens a gateway to the celestial plane. The gate appears as a shimmering circle that sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet and is framed by twisting, golden strands. The gate lasts 1 hour; though, the zoryas can choose to close it at any time as a bonus action. Once the gate closes, the zoryas is reduced to 0 hp and remains unconscious for six days, awakening, fully restored, at sunrise on the seventh day. The zoryas can't pass through its own gate.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The zoryas regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the zoryas takes necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the zoryas' next turn. The zoryas' body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

features.name: Sun's Guidance (3/Day)
features.description: The zoryas has advantage on melee attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The angel makes two morningstar attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant or fire damage.

actions.name: Light of Dawn (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.description: The zoryas' lantern brightens, bathing its environs in brilliant light. Each creature within 30 feet of the zoryas must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1d4 rounds. An undead creature who fails this save also takes 13 (3d8) fire damage. The light dispels up to three spells or other magical effects of 3rd level or lower like the dispel magic spell within the area.

actions.name: Dusk's Arrival (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.description: The zoryas' lantern darkens, snuffing out nearby natural and magical sources of light. Each creature within 30 feet of the zoryas must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area is bathed in darkness like the darkness spell until the end of the zoryas' next turn.

name: Bat King
speed: 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (bat or hybrid form only)

features.name: Speak to Bats
features.description: The Bat King can communicate with bats as if they shared a language.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The Bat King's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: pass without trace, shatter, thunderwave
3/day each: darkness, scrying
2/day each: etherealness, freedom of movement
1/day each: astral projection, teleport

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: The Bat King makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Blood Bite (Bat or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werebat lycanthropy.

actions.name: Oblivion's Mace (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (4d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Screech (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Bat King lets loose an ear-shattering screech in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in that area that can hear the screech must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 33 (6d10) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a success, the creature takes half the thunder damage but isn't deafened. This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Summon Bats (2/Day)
actions.description: The Bat King magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats. In an urban environment, he can call 1 werebat (see page 258) instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the Bat King and obeying his spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the Bat King dies, or until the Bat King dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary_actions.name: At Will Spell
legendary_actions.description: The Bat King casts one of his at will spells.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.description: The Bat King makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Flight (Bat or Hybrid Form Only)
legendary_actions.description: The Bat King flies up to his flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Brother Ox
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Bovine Passivism
features.description: No bovine creatures or wereboars can willingly attack Brother Ox. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

features.name: Charge
features.description: If Brother Ox moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack, the target takes an extra 11 (2d10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
features.description: If Brother Ox fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Brother Ox has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: Brother Ox's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Rejuvenation
features.description: If he dies, Brother Ox's soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In 1d6 days, it inhabits the body of another bovine on the Material Plane which becomes Brother Ox with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every bovine on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: Brother Ox can use his action to polymorph into a Huge ox, a Medium bald human with a short, dark beard, or back into his true Huge ox-headed humanoid form. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying transforms with him.

features.name: Speak with Bovines
features.description: Brother Ox can communicate with any bovine creature as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: In ox or human form, Brother Ox makes three melee attacks. In his true form, he makes three attacks: one with his gore and two with his unarmed strike.

actions.name: Gore (Ox or True Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Humanoid or True Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Ki Disruption (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Brother Ox makes one unarmed strike against a creature to create an instability within the target's essence that lasts 2d8 days. This instability is harmless unless Brother Ox uses his action to end it early. To do so, Brother Ox and the target must be on the same plane of existence. Brother Ox can use this action again to force the target to make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is reduced to 0 hp. On a success, it takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Deflect Missiles (Humanoid or True Form Only)
reactions.description: When Brother Ox is hit by a ranged weapon attack, he can reduce the damage he takes by 25 (1d10 + 20). If this reduces the damage to 0, Brother Ox can catch the missile if it fits in one hand and he has one hand free. If Brother Ox catches a missile in this way, he can throw the missile as a ranged weapon attack as part of the same reaction. The missile has +10 to hit, with a short range of 30 feet and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, it deals 18 (3d8 + 5) damage of a type appropriate to the missile.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: Brother Ox moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Wholeness
legendary_actions.description: Brother Ox regains 10 hp, is cured of all diseases, and ends one effect lowering his ability scores or hp maximum. Brother Ox can't use this legendary action again until the end of his next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Stunning Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Brother Ox makes one unarmed strike. If it hits a creature, the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Lord of Vultures
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Bird Passivism
features.description: No bird or ravenfolk can willingly attack Sampati. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: Sampati has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and can’t be surprised.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If Sampati fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Sampati has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: Sampati’s weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: Sampati has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of his allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

features.name: Rejuvenation
features.description: If he dies, Sampati’s soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In 1d6 days, it inhabits the body of another bird of prey on the Material Plane which becomes the Lord of Vultures with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every bird of prey on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: Sampati can use his action to polymorph into a Huge giant vulture, a Medium dark-skinned man with black and gold hair, or back into his true Large, winged humanoid form. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form with the exception that only Sampati’s true and vulture forms retain his flying speed. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying transforms with him.

features.name: Speak with Birds
features.description: Sampati can communicate with birds as if they shared a language.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Sampati’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: animal friendship, thunderwave
3/day each: charm person, conjure animals (birds only, cast as a 9th-level spell), dominate beast
1/day each: antimagic field, geas, plane shift

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: In humanoid or his true form, Sampati makes three spear attacks. In vulture form, he makes three attacks: one with his beak and two with his talons.

actions.name: Spear (Humanoid or True Form Only)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If Sampati throws the spear, it magically reforms in his hand immediately after the attack.

actions.name: Beak (Vulture Form Only)

features.name: Magic Resistance

features.name: Innate Spellcasting

The Mouse King's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: animal friendship (rats and mice only), speak with animals (rats and mice only)
3/day each: confusion, conjure animals (rats and mice only), misty step
1/day: commune with nature (as an action)

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The Mouse King has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Rodent Empathy
features.description: The Mouse King can communicate with rodents and uses his Charisma when making Charisma checks with rodents.

features.description: The Mouse King deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the Mouse King that isn't incapacitated and the Mouse King doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Mouse King makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Queen of Birds
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Bird Passivism
features.description: No bird or ravenfolk can willingly attack the Queen. They can be forced to do so through magical means.

features.name: Flyby
features.description: The Queen of Birds doesn’t provoke an opportunity attack when she flies out of an enemy’s reach.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
features.description: If the Queen of Birds fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The Queen of Birds has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Rejuvenation
features.description: If she dies, the Queen of Birds’ soul reforms on the Astral Plane. In 1d6 days, it inhabits the body of another bird on the Material Plane which becomes the Queen of Birds with all of the hp and abilities thereof. Only killing every bird on the Material Plane will prevent this trait from functioning.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The Queen of Birds can use her action to polymorph into a Large jewel-toned eagle, a Medium long‑haired elven woman, or back into her true Large, winged humanoid form. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form with the exception that only her true and eagle forms retain her flying speed. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her.

features.name: Speak with Birds
features.description: The Queen of Birds can communicate with birds as if they shared a language.

features.name: Storm Strike Weapons
features.description: The Queen of Birds’ weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with a weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 2d8 damage of her choice of lightning or thunder damage (included in the attack).

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The Queen of Bird’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components: 
At will: dispel magic, gust of wind, spiritual weapon
3/day each: chain lightning, counterspell
1/day: control weather

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: In eagle or humanoid form, the Queen of Birds makes two attacks. In her true form, she makes three attacks: one with her talons and two with her spear.

actions.name: Storm Spear (Humanoid or True Form Only)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 100/300 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning or thunder damage, or 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning or thunder damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the Queen of Birds throws her storm spear, it magically reforms in her hand immediately after the attack.

actions.name: Talons (Eagle or True Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning or thunder damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the Queen of Birds can automatically hit the target with her talons, and she can’t make talons attacks against other targets. When the Queen of Birds moves, any Medium or smaller target she is grappling moves with her.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The Queen of Birds adds 5 to her AC against one melee weapon attack that would hit her. To do so, the Queen of Birds must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

legendary_actions.name: Soar (Eagle or True Form Only)
legendary_actions.description: The Queen of Birds flies up to her flying speed.

legendary_actions.name: Storm Spear (Humanoid or True Form Only)
legendary_actions.description: The Queen of Birds makes a storm spear attack.

legendary_actions.name: Swooping Death (Costs 2 Actions; Eagle or True Form Only)
legendary_actions.description: The Queen of Birds makes an attack with her talons. If the attack hits, she can fly up to half her flying speed.

features.description: The anophiloi can pinpoint, by scent, the location of living creatures within 30 feet of it.

While attached, the anophiloi doesn’t attack. Instead, at the start of each of the anophiloi’s turns, the target loses 5 (1d6 + 2) hp due to blood loss.  
	 The anophiloi can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 20 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the anophiloi by succeed on a DC 13 Strength check.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

features.name: Shearing

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The arborcyte makes two thorn vine attacks plus one animated tendril attack for each tendril it can see that has been created through its Shearing trait.

actions.name: Thorn Vine
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).  Until this grapple ends, the target takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the arborcyte’s turns, and tendril attacks against the target have advantage. The arborcyte can grapple up to two creatures at one time.

actions.name: Animated Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

features.description: While attached to a host, the arcamag has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

features.description: The arcamag can use its action to polymorph into a small object, such as a ring, wand, orb, rod, or scroll. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

features.description: While motionless, the arcamag is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

actions.name: Attach
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that can cast spells. Hit: The arcamag attaches to the target. While attached, the arcamag doesn’t attack. Instead, it causes a handful of changes in its spellcaster host (see Changes to the Host sidebar). The arcamag can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature other than the host can use its action to detach the arcamag by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check. The host can use its action to detach the arcamag only after the host has expended all of its spell slots for the day, including the extra cantrips and spell slots gained from having the arcamag attached. Doing so doesn’t require a Strength check. When the arcamag detaches itself or is detached from a host, the host takes 2 (1d4) psychic damage per spellcaster level.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Day)
actions.description: The arcamag magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space. If it is attached to a host when it uses this action, it automatically detaches.

name: Arcanaphage
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from magical weapons
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 12

features.name: Arcane Discharge
features.description: When an arcanaphage dies, it explodes in a surge of partially-digested magical energy. Each creature within 5 feet per Feed score must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) force damage per Feed score on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. For 1 minute afterward, the affected area is awash with volatile magic. A creature that starts its turn in the affected area takes 7 (2d6) force damage.

features.name: Hunger
features.description: Each time it feeds in combat, it regains hp equal to twice the level of the spell it ate and increases its Feed score by 1. The arcanaphage can’t have a Feed score higher than 8, and its Feed score reduces by 1 each time it finishes a long rest.

features.name: Ingest Magic
features.description: At the start of each of the arcanaphage’s turns, each creature within 30 feet of it that is currently maintaining concentration on a spell must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature’s spell ends and the arcanaphage feeds.

features.name: Magic Immunity
features.description: The arcanaphage is immune to damage from spells. It has advantage on saving throws against all other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The arcanaphage makes two tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Voracious
reactions.description: The arcanaphage’s tentacles glow when a spell is cast within 30 feet of it, countering the spell. This reaction works like the counterspell spell, except the arcanaphage must always make a spellcasting ability check, no matter the spell level. Its ability check for this is +5. If it successfully counters the spell, the arcanaphage feeds.

name: Astral Snapper
damage_resistances: bludgeoning and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Astral Devour
features.description:
A creature hosting an astral snapper's astral form must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw each time it finishes a long rest. On a success, the astral snapper is ejected from the host and the Astral Plane into an unoccupied space in the Material Plane within 10 feet of the host and is stunned for 1 round. On a failure, the astral snapper consumes part of the host's internal organs, reducing the host's Constitution score by 1d4. The host dies if this reduces its Constitution to 0. The reduction lasts until the host finishes a long rest after the astral snapper has been expelled. If the host's Constitution score is reduced to 0, the astral snapper exits the host's body in the Material Plane by tearing its way out through the abdomen. The astral snapper becomes completely corporeal as it exits the host, stepping out of the host at its full size. 
	 From the time the astral snapper succeeds on the initial dive into the host through the Astral Plane until the moment it emerges from the host's abdomen, it can be seen by any creature that can see into the Astral Plane—its head buried in the host's back. The astral snapper has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and is effectively stunned when in this position until it takes damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The astral snapper makes two attacks with its claws. If both attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or its wound becomes a rift to the Astral Plane. The astral snapper immediately passes through, closing the rift behind it. The target is then affected by the astral snapper's Astral Devour trait.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.
