actions.name: Ghostly Grasp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Chilling Moan (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The phantom emits an eerie moan. Each creature within 30 feet that isn't an undead or a construct must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 9 (2d8) cold damage and is frightened until the end of the phantom's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't frightened.

name: Philosopher's Ghost
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

features.name: Illumination
features.description: The philosopher's ghost sheds bright light in a 20-foot-radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

features.name: Persistent Burning Form
features.description: The philosopher's ghost can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the ghost or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the philosopher's ghost can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

features.name: Siege Monster
features.description: The philosopher's ghost deals double damage to objects and structures.

features.name: Water Vulnerability
features.description: If completely immersed in water, a philosopher's ghost's movement halves each round until it stops moving completely, becoming incapacitated, and contact with it no longer causes damage. As soon as any portion of it is exposed to the air again, it resumes moving at full speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The philosopher's ghost makes two burning touch attacks.

actions.name: Burning Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it suffers a burning lesion, taking 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. Any creature can take an action to soothe the burning lesion with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The lesion is also soothed if the target receives magical healing.

name: Piasa
senses: blindsight 15 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 14

features.name: Segmented Tail
features.description: The piasa's spiked tail is segmented and up to three times the length of its body. When the piasa takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, a segment of its tail is severed. When the first segment is severed, the tail attack's damage type changes from piercing to bludgeoning and deals 1d8 less damage. When the second segment is severed, the tail attack no longer deals damage, but it can still grapple. When the third segment is severed, the piasa can't make tail attacks. The tail re-grows at a rate of one segment per long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The piasa can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite or tail and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.  If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the piasa can't make tail attacks against other targets. When the piasa moves, any Medium or smaller creature it is grappling moves with it.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the piasa's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the piasa's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Sleep Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The piasa exhales sleep gas in a 30-foot cone.  Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes.  This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

name: Pillar of the Lost Magocracy
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: understands Common but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

features.name: Mental Agility
features.description: The pillar uses its Intelligence instead of its Dexterity to determine its place in the initiative order.

features.name: Shocking Vengeance
features.description: A creature that touches the pillar or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Anger of the Ancient Mage
actions.description:
The pillar of lost magocracy unleashes a random magical attack on a target or area within 120 feet. Roll a d4 to determine the effect:
1. Mutant Plants. Grasping tendrils of alien vegetation sprout from the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point the pillar can see within 120 feet. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or become restrained. Treat as an entangle spell, except it only lasts for 2d4 rounds. 
2. Acid Rain. Corrosive acid falls from the sky centered on a point the pillar can see within 120 feet. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. 
3. Noxious Cloud. The pillar creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of reddish, stinging mist centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. The area is heavily obscured, and each creature inside the cloud at the start of its turn must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 13 (3d8) poison damage and is blinded until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. The cloud lasts for 1d4 rounds.
4. Shrinking Ray. A bright green ray strikes a single creature within 120 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be shrunk to half its size. Treat as an enlarge/reduce spell, except it lasts for 2d4 rounds.

features.name: Consume Treasure
features.description: The pixiu has an appetite for gold, silver, and jewels and consumes them whenever possible. If the pixiu attempts to eat a magical coin, gemstone, or piece of jewelry, the object has a 25% chance of breaking, dispelling its magic and rendering it useless. If the object doesn’t break, the pixiu gives up trying to eat it.

features.name: Protector of Qi
features.description: The pixiu is immune to disease and to effects that would lower its maximum hp. In addition, each ally within 10 feet of the pixiu has advantage on saving throws against disease and is immune to effects that would lower its maximum hp.

features.name: Treasure Sense
features.description: A pixiu can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pixiu makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Alabaster Tree
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 15

features.name: Churning Advance
features.description: As a bonus action, the alabaster tree moves up to five times its speed, leaving a trail of difficult terrain behind it.

features.name: Foster the Grasses
features.description: Hallowed reeds within 60 feet of an alabaster tree have advantage on saving throws.

features.name: Like Calls to Like
features.description: The alabaster tree knows if a creature within 60 feet of it is good-aligned or not.

features.name: Soul's Respite
features.description: A good-aligned creature who takes a short rest within 10 feet of an alabaster tree gains all the benefits of a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The alabaster tree makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage and the creature is grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Serrated Squeeze (Willow Only)
actions.description:
The alabaster tree makes one slam attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is engulfed in razor-sharp leaves, and the grapple ends. While engulfed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside of the leaves, and it takes 13 (3d8) slashing damage at the start of each of the alabaster tree’s turns. An alabaster tree can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

If the alabaster tree takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from the engulfed creature, the alabaster tree must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or release the creature in a shower of shredded leaves. The released creature falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the alabaster tree. If the alabaster tree dies, an engulfed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the leaves and branches by using an action to untangle itself.

actions.name: Toss (Oak Only)
actions.description: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by the alabaster tree is thrown up to 40 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Cloud of Needles (Recharge 5-6, Pine Only)
actions.description: The alabaster tree fires a cloud of sharp needles at all creatures within 30 feet of it. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Grinding Maw
features.description: The devil bough has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by its bite attack.

features.name: Like Calls to Like
features.description: The devil bough knows if a creature within 60 feet of it is evil-aligned or not.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil bough makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the devil bough can’t make bite attacks against other targets.

reactions.name: Arcasynthesis
reactions.description: When a spell of 5th level or lower is cast within 100 feet of the devil bough, it attempts to synthesize the magic. The spell resolves as normal, but the devil bough has a 50% chance of regaining 5 (1d10) hp per level of the spell cast.

name: Ecstatic Bloom
senses: truesight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 19

features.name: Aura of Life
features.description: When an undead creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the bloom, it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be turned until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Blessed Regrowth
features.description: At the start of each of the ecstatic bloom’s turns, the bloom and each good-aligned creature, including the bloom, within 10 feet of it regains 4 (1d8) hp. If the bloom takes fire damage, this trait doesn’t function at the start of the bloom’s next turn. The ecstatic bloom dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn’t regain hp from this trait.

features.name: Foster the Trees
features.description: Alabaster trees within 60 feet of the ecstatic bloom have advantage on all saving throws.

features.name: Like Calls to Like
features.description: The ecstatic bloom knows if a creature within 120 feet of it is good-aligned or not.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ecstatic bloom makes three gilded beam attacks.

actions.name: Gilded Beam
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Castigate (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The bloom summons a chorus of booming celestial voices that descend into the minds of nearby creatures. Each creature within 30 feet of the bloom must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. Castigate only affects non‑good‑aligned creatures with an Intelligence of 5 or higher.

features.name: Healed by Blood
features.description: Whenever a creature is reduced to 0 hp within 60 feet of the execrable shrub, the shrub regains 5 (1d10) hp.

features.name: Like Calls to Like
features.description: The execrable shrub knows if a creature within 60 feet of it is evil-aligned or not.

features.name: Limited Telepathy
features.description: Using telepathy, the execrable shrub can magically communicate with any other evil-aligned creature within 100 feet of it. This communication is primarily through images and emotions rather than actual words.

actions.name: Burning Slash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Smolder (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The execrable shrub releases a billowing cloud of smoke in a 10-foot-radius that lasts for 1 minute and moves with the shrub. The area affected by the smoke is heavily obscured.

name: Hallowed Reed
senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 14

features.name: Like Calls to Like
features.description: The hallowed reed knows if a creature within 30 feet of it is good-aligned or not.

features.name: Limited Telepathy
features.description: Using telepathy, a hallowed reed can magically communicate with any other good-aligned creature within 100 feet of it. This communication is primarily through images and emotions rather than actual words.

features.name: Rebirth
features.description: If a hallowed reed is slain, a new patch of hallowed reeds will grow in the same spot starting within a week of its death. Charring or salting the ground where a hallowed reed was slain prevents this resurgence.

actions.name: Searing Grasp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) radiant damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, it takes 2 (1d4) radiant damage at the start of each of its turns, and the hallowed reed can’t grasp another target. Undead and fiends have disadvantage on ability checks made to escape the grapple.

features.name: Burning Tangle
features.description: The ground within 10 feet of the thorned sulfurlord is difficult terrain.

features.name: Hell Core
features.description: At the start of each of the thorned sulfurlord’s turns, each creature within 10 feet of the sulfurlord takes 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the thorned sulfurlord takes cold damage, this trait doesn’t function at the start of its next turn.

features.name: Like Calls to Like
features.description: The thorned sulfurlord knows if a creature within 100 feet of it is evil-aligned or not.

features.name: Root (3/Day)
features.description: As a bonus action, the thorned sulfurlord sends its roots deep into the ground. For 1 minute, the sulfurlord’s speed is halved, it is immune to effects that would move it, and it can’t be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The thorned sulfurlord makes two sulfur slam attacks or two fiery spike attacks.

actions.name: Sulfur Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Fiery Spike
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

actions.name: The World Shall Know Fire (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The thorned sulfurlord targets a creature that has taken fire damage from it within the last minute and causes a burst of fire to expand out from that creature in a 30-foot-radius. Each creature in the area, including the target, must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried.

name: Purple Slime
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The purple slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The purple slime can breathe air and water.

features.name: Underwater Camouflage
features.description: The purple slime has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The purple slime makes two spike attacks.

actions.name: Spike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and 10 (3d6) poison damage. In addition, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

name: Quickstep
senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 14

features.name: Evasion
features.description: If the quickstep is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the quickstep instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: The quickstep has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put it to sleep.

features.name: Startling Speed
features.description: The movements of a quickstep are so swift that it is almost invisible when in motion. If the quickstep moves at least 10 feet on its turn, attack rolls against it have disadvantage until the start of its next turn unless the quickstep is incapacitated or restrained.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: A quickstep makes two attacks with its moonlight rapier and one with its hidden dagger.

actions.name: Moonlight Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Hidden Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Steel (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet of the quickstep must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw as the quickstep whirls in a blur of cold steel. On a failure, a target takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) cold damage and is paralyzed for 1 round. On a success, a target takes half the piercing and cold damage and isn’t paralyzed.

reactions.name: Quick Dodge
reactions.description: When a creature the quickstep can see targets it with an attack, the quickstep can move to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it without provoking opportunity attacks. If this movement would put the quickstep out of reach of the attacker, the attack misses.

name: Quiet Soul
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 17
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can’t speak

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While the quiet soul remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary humanoid corpse.

features.name: Melancholic Emanation
features.description: The quiet soul emits a magical aura of lethargy and despondency. Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the quiet soul must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute. The effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or another creature uses an action to wake it.

actions.name: Psychic Lash
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) psychic damage. If an unconscious creature is hit by this attack, that creature must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, remaining unconscious on a failed save, or waking on a successful one.

features.name: Natural Camouflage
features.description: The rageipede has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while in forests and tall grass.

features.name: Surprise Bite
features.description: If the rageipede surprises a creature and hits it with a bite attack during the first round of combat, the target has disadvantage on its saving throw against the rage caused by the rageipede's bite.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rageipede makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be overcome with a fit of rage for 1 minute. While in a fit of rage, a creature has advantage on melee attack rolls and its melee weapon attacks deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage. The creature is unable to distinguish friend from foe and must attack the nearest creature other than the rageipede. If no other creature is near enough to move to and attack, the victim stalks off in a random direction, seeking a target for its rage. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Greater Rakshasa
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Limited Magic Immunity
features.description: The greater rakshasa can’t be affected or detected by spells of 7th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

features.name: Puppet Master
features.description: When the greater rakshasa casts the charm person spell, it can target up to five creatures. When it casts the dominate person spell, the spell’s duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The greater rakshasa’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The greater rakshasa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 
At will: detect thoughts, disguise self, mage hand, minor illusion 
3/day each: charm person, detect magic, invisibility, major image, suggestion 
1/day each: dominate person, fly, plane shift, true seeing

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The greater rakshasa makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is cursed if it is a creature. The magical curse takes effect whenever the target takes a short or long rest, filling the target’s thoughts with horrible images and dreams. The cursed target gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Harrowing Visions (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The greater rakshasa chooses a point it can see within 60 feet, conjuring a terrifying manifestation of its enemies’ worst fears in a 30-foot-radius around the point. Each non-rakshasa in the area must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 66 (12d10) psychic damage and becomes frightened for 1 minute. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn’t frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary_actions.name: Claw Attack
legendary_actions.description: The greater rakshasa makes one claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Misleading Escape (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greater rakshasa becomes invisible at the same time that an illusory double of itself appears where it is standing. This switch is indiscernible to others. After the double appears, the greater rakshasa can move up to its speed. Both effects last until the start of the greater rakshasa’s next turn, but the invisibility ends if the greater rakshasa makes an attack or casts a spell before then.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The greater rakshasa casts a spell from its list of innate spells, consuming a use of the spell as normal.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The ramag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The ramag portal master is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, prestidigitation, shocking grasp
1st level (4 slots): burning hands, mage armor, magic missile
2nd level (3 slots): arcane lock, hold person, levitate, misty step
3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, dispel magic, fireball
4th level (1 slot): banishment

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ramag portal master makes two lightning stroke attacks.

actions.name: Gate Seal
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) force damage.

actions.name: Lightning Stroke
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it can’t take reactions until the start of the ramag’s next turn.

actions.name: Dimensional Seal (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The ramag magically empowers its gate seal to dampen teleportation, planar gates, and portals within 60 feet of it. A creature that attempts to teleport while within or into the area must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or the teleport fails. Spells and abilities that conjure creatures or objects automatically fail, and portals or gates are suppressed while they remain in the area. The seal lasts 1 hour, or until the ramag loses concentration on it as if concentrating on a spell.

actions.name: Weave Dimensions
actions.description: The ramag creates two magical gateways in unoccupied spaces it can see within 100 feet of it. The gateways appear as shimmering, opaque ovals in the air. A creature that moves into one gateway appears at the other immediately. The gateways last for 1 minute, or until the ramag loses concentration on them as if concentrating on a spell.

name: Ratatosk Warlord
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: I’m Bigger That’s Why
features.description: As a bonus action, the ratatosk warlord commands one ratatosk within 30 feet of it to make one melee attack as a reaction.

features.name: Warlord Skitter
features.description: The ratatosk warlord can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ratatosk warlord makes two attacks: one with its gore and one with its ratatosk shortspear.

actions.name: Ratatosk Shortspear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Chatter of War (Recharges 5-6)
actions.description: Each non-ratatosk creature within 30 feet that can hear the warlord must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls until the start of the warlord’s next turn.

features.name: Chopper Squad
features.description: The ratfolk mercenary's melee weapon attacks deal one extra die of damage if at least one of the mercenary's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

features.name: Nimbleness
features.description: The ratfolk mercenary can move through the space of any Medium or larger creature.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The ratfolk has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ratfolk's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

features.name: Packing Heat
features.description: If the ratfolk mercenary moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a shortsword attack on the same turn, the mercenary can make one dart attack against another target within 20 feet as a bonus action without disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ratfolk mercenary makes two attacks with its shortsword or dart. If both shortsword attacks hit the same target, the ratfolk mercenary can use its bonus action to automatically deal an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage as it bites the target.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Guard the Big Cheese
reactions.description: When a creature makes an attack against the ratfolk mercenary's current employer, the mercenary grants a +2 bonus to the employer's AC if the mercenary is within 5 feet of the employer.

features.name: Nimbleness
features.description: The ratfolk warlock can move through the space of any Medium or larger creature.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The ratfolk has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ratfolk's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The ratfolk warlock's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights, eldritch blast, fire bolt, mage armor, mage hand, minor illusion, poison spray, speak with animals
3/day each: command, darkness, hellish rebuke
1/day each: blindness/deafness, hold person

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Darken
actions.description: The ratfolk warlock causes tendrils of shadow to reach out from its body toward all creatures within 10 feet of it. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be restrained by the tendrils until the end of the ratfolk warlock's next turn.

name: Razorleaf
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 14

features.name: Dark Ground
features.description: As an action, the razorleaf can dig its roots into the ground, securing itself in place and causing the area in a 20-foot radius around it to be shrouded in shadow. While rooted in this way, the razorleaf's speed becomes 0, it can't be knocked prone, and its attacks deal an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. This area is difficult terrain and nonmagical sources of light are only half as effective while within it. Small and smaller beasts with Intelligence 3 or lower in the area lose their natural coloration and turn pale grey. These creatures are charmed by the razorleaf while within the area. Plants and trees inside the area turn an ashen color. The razorleaf can recall its roots and end this effect as a bonus action.

features.name: Do Not Touch
features.description: A creature that touches the razorleaf or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

features.name: Light Sensitivity
features.description: While in bright light, the razorleaf has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The razorleaf makes two lacerating leaves attacks.

actions.name: Lacerating Leaves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shower of Razors (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The razorleaf shakes loose a deadly shower of slicing leaves. Each creature within 10 feet of the razorleaf must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Ring Servant
languages: understands the language of its creator but can't speak

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: The ring servant is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The ring servant's slam attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ring servant makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ring of Destruction (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ring servant discharges a spinning ring of magical energy. Each creature within 20 feet of the servant must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Roachling Scout
senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 10 ft., passive Perception 16

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The roachling scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Resistant
features.description: The roachling scout has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

features.name: Stealthy Traveler
features.description: The roachling scout can move stealthily while traveling at a normal pace.

features.name: Unlovely
features.description: The roachling scout has disadvantage on Charisma (Performance) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks in interactions with non‑roachlings.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roachling scout makes two begrimed shortsword attacks or two begrimed dart attacks.

actions.name: Begrimed Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Begrimed Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

name: Roggenwolf
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silver

features.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
features.description: The roggenwolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing and smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Howl (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The roggenwolf lets loose a howl that can only be heard inside the minds of nearby creatures. Each creature within 30 feet of the roggenwolf that isn't an undead or a construct must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened and restrained for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending both effects on itself on a success.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The scitalis has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Stunning Scales
actions.description: Each creature of the scitalis’ choice that is within 60 feet of the scitalis and can see it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the scitalis’ Stunning Scales for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The scrag can breathe air and water

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The lesser scrag regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it is in contact with water. If the scrag takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn’t function at the start of the scrag’s next turn. The scrag dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn’t regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lesser scrag makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4)

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4)

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The scrag can breathe air and water.

features.name: Blood Frenzy
features.description: The scrag has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all of its hp.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The greater scrag regains 10 hp at the start of its turn if it is in contact with water. If the scrag takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn’t function at the start of the scrag’s next turn. The scrag dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn’t regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The greater scrag makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5)

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d4 + 5)

name: Sentinel in Darkness
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

features.name: Scourge of the Seekers
features.description: The sentinel has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with darkvision, blindsight, or truesight.

features.name: Vault Keeper
features.description: Secret doors and illusory walls within 1,500 feet of the sentinel have the DC to detect their presence increased by 5.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sentinel makes two stone fist attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or lose one non-weapon, non-armor object that is small enough to fit in one hand. The object is teleported to a random unoccupied space within 200 feet of the sentinel. The target feels a mental tug in the general direction of the item until it is recovered.

actions.name: Stone Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Curse of the Wanderer (Recharge 6)
actions.description: One creature the sentinel can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or suffer the Curse of the Wanderer. While cursed, the creature's speed is halved and it can't regain hp. For every 24 hours it goes without discovering or learning new information, it takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The curse lasts until it is lifted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The serpentfolk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The serpentfolk's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The serpentfolk can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: charm person, disguise self

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The serpentfolk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its scimitar.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Servant of Yig
senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive perception 11

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The Servant of Yig has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The Servant of Yig's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The servant can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: charm person, fear
1/day: confusion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The servant of Yig makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its glaive.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned this way, the target is incapacitated and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the Servant of Yig can't constrict another target.

name: Shadow Blight
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 13

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While the shadow blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from the stump of a dead tree.

actions.name: Frozen Shadow Tendril
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) cold damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Animate Plants (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The shadow blight magically animates 1d4 plants within 60 feet of it, turning them into awakened shrubs under its control. These plants' attacks deal an additional 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the shrubs are not destroyed before 1 hour passes, they become new shadow blights.

name: Shadow River Lord
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The shadow river lord can move through a space as narrow as one inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadow river lord makes two greenfire staff or two shadowfrost bolt attacks. If two attacks hit the same target, the target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Greenfire Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Shadowfrost Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Shadow Geyser (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The shadow river lord expels a geyser of shadowy water from its staff in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage and 21 (6d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Shantak
languages: understands Common and Void Speech, but can’t speak

features.name: Eldritch Sight
features.description: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the shantak’s darkvision.

features.name: Flyby
features.description: The shantak doesn’t provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

features.name: Keen Sight and Smell
features.description: The shantak has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The shantak has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The shantak has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the shantak’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

features.name: Unctuous Hide
features.description: A shantak’s hide is very slippery. A rider can dismount a shantak without any penalty to movement speed. If an effect moves the shantak against its will while a creature is on it, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall off the shantak, landing prone in a space within 5 feet of it. If a rider is knocked prone or unconscious while mounted, it must make the same saving throw. In addition, the shantak can attempt to shake off a rider as a bonus action, forcing the rider to make the saving throw to stay mounted.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shantak makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its talons.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Insane Tittering (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The shantak emits a horrific screech. Each non-shantak creature within 60 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be frightened until the end of the shantak’s next turn. The shantak can choose to include or exclude its rider when using this action.

name: Shard Swarm
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 7

features.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
features.description: The swarm is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by the dispel magic spell, the swarm must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

features.name: Come Together (3/Day)
features.description: If the shard swarm has at least 1 hit point and all of its pieces are within 30 feet of each other, the pieces can re-form as a bonus action in any space containing at least one of its pieces.

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While the swarm remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal pile of junk.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a pebble. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Shards
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage or 2 (1d4) slashing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or less.

actions.name: Shrapnel
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage. A piece of the swarm breaks off, falling into the target's space.

actions.name: Contain (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The shard swarm envelopes one Medium or smaller creature in its space. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained inside the swarm for 1 minute. The target has disadvantage on this saving throw if the shard swarm used Come Together to form in the target's space. While restrained, the target doesn't take damage from the swarm's Shards action, but it takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage if it takes an action that requires movement, such as attacking or casting a spell with somatic components. A creature within 5 feet of the swarm can take an action to pull a restrained creature out of the swarm. Doing so requires a successful DC 13 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The shoreline scrapper can breathe air and water.

features.name: Magnetic Shell
features.description: At the start of each of the shoreline scrapper's turns, each creature within 5 feet of the scrapper must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or the metal items worn or carried by it stick to the scrapper's shell. A creature that is made of metal or is wearing metal armor that fails the saving throw is stuck to the shell and restrained.  If the item is a weapon and the wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is adhered to the shell and is restrained. A stuck item can't be used. A creature can take its action to remove one creature or object from the shoreline scrapper's shell by succeeding on a DC 15 Strength check.  Items made of gold and silver are unaffected by the shoreline scrapper's Magnetic Shell. When the shoreline scrapper dies, all metal creatures and objects are released.

features.name: Metal Sense
features.description: The shoreline scrapper can pinpoint, by scent, the location of metals within 60 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shoreline scrapper makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Magnetic Pulse (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The shoreline scrapper causes a surge in the magnetic power of its shell. Each creature within 25 feet of the shoreline scrapper is subjected to its Magnetic Shell. On a failed save, a creature's metal objects or the creature itself, if it is made of metal or wearing metal armor, are pulled up to 25 feet toward the shoreline scrapper and adhere to its shell. Creatures adhered to the shoreline scrapper's shell are restrained.

reactions.name: Shell Protection
reactions.description: The shoreline scrapper adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it as it withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it increases its AC by 4, has a speed of 0 ft., and can't use its claws or magnetic pulse. The shoreline scrapper can emerge from its shell as a bonus action.

name: Avatar of Shoth
senses: blindsight 60 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 22

features.name: Absorbent
features.description: When the avatar damages a creature, it absorbs a portion of that creature’s knowledge and power. As a bonus action, it can recreate any action available to a creature it damaged within the last minute. This includes spells and actions with limited uses or with a recharge. This recreated action is resolved using the avatar’s statistics where applicable.

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The avatar, including its equipment, can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the avatar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Soothing Aura
features.description: Any creature hostile to the avatar that starts its turn within 30 feet of the avatar must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Creatures with Intelligence 3 or lower automatically fail the saving throw.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
features.description:
The avatar’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell casting DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks). It may cast the following spells innately, requiring no components: 
At will: acid splash (4d6), light, spare the dying, true strike
3/day each: bless, blur, command, darkness, enthrall, shield
2/day each: counterspell, dispel magic
1/day each: black tentacles, confusion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The avatar makes three oozing tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Oozing Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage and 14 (4d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Legendary Merge
actions.description: A shoth with less than half its maximum hp can merge with any other shoth creature within 10 feet, adding its remaining hp to that creature’s. The hp gained this way can exceed the normal maximum of that creature. The avatar can accept any number of such mergers.

actions.name: Acid Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The avatar rises up and crashes down, releasing a 20-foot radius wave of acidic ooze. Each creature in the area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 67 (15d8) acid damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t knocked prone.

actions.name: Consult the Zom (1/Day)
actions.description: The avatar uses its action to consult its weighty zom for insight. The zom flashes brilliant crimson‑and‑white light. Each creature within 120 feet who can see the avatar must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn. Each creature of the avatar’s choice within 120 feet that speaks a language must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn as the avatar telepathically utters a short expression that is particularly meaningful to that creature.

legendary_actions.name: At Will Spell
legendary_actions.description: The avatar casts one at will spell.

legendary_actions.name: Oozing Tentacle
legendary_actions.description: The avatar makes one oozing tentacle attack.

legendary_actions.name: Acid Wave (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The avatar uses Acid Wave, if it is available.

features.name: Absorbent (3/Day)
features.description: When the droth damages a creature, it absorbs a portion of that creature’s knowledge and power. As a bonus action, it can recreate any action available to a creature it damaged within the last minute. This includes spells and actions with limited uses or with a recharge. This recreated action is resolved using the droth’s statistics where applicable.

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The droth, including its equipment, can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: Soothing Aura
features.description: Any creature hostile to the droth that starts its turn within 20 feet of the droth must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Creatures with Intelligence 3 or lower automatically fail the saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The droth makes two oozing crush attacks.

actions.name: Oozing Crush
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Merge
actions.description: A shoth with less than half its maximum hp can merge with any other shoth creature within 10 feet, adding its remaining hp to that creature’s. The hp gained this way can exceed the normal maximum of that creature. A shoth can accept one such merger every 24 hours.

actions.name: Acid Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The droth rises up and crashes down, releasing a 20-foot-radius wave of acidic ooze. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 (10d8) acid damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t knocked prone.

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The oth, including its equipment, can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: Multiple Roles
features.description:
Choose either the Dripping Arcanist or Paladin of Shoth trait.
•	Dripping Arcanist. The oth’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell casting DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It may cast the following spells innately, requiring only verbal components:

Cantrip (at will): fire bolt (2d10), light, thaumaturgy

3/day each: command, mage armor, magic missile

2/day each: augury, detect thoughts

1/day: fireball
•	Paladin of Shoth. The oth derives its power from Shoth itself, its zom shining with sacred light. Its Armor Class increases by 2. A non-shoth creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the oth must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be blinded by the light of Shoth until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oth makes two oozing slam attacks or one oozing slam and one greatsword attack.

actions.name: Oozing Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and 2 (1d4) acid damage.

actions.name: Greatsword (Paladin of Shoth Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Merge
actions.description: A shoth who has less than half its maximum hp can merge with any other shoth creature within 10 feet, adding its remaining hp to that creature’s. The hp gained this way can exceed the normal maximum of that creature. A shoth can accept one such merger every 24 hours.

actions.name: Spray (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The oth sprays acid in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The sooze, including its equipment, can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: Multiple Roles
features.description:
Choose either the Laborer or Warrior trait.
•	Laborer. The sooze is strong and tireless. It gains immunity to exhaustion and can Dash as a bonus action 3 times each day.
•	Warrior. The sooze is trained and equipped as a warrior. Its Armor Class increases by 2. The sooze has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Oozing Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and 2 (1d4) acid damage.

actions.name: Longsword (Warrior Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Merge
actions.description: A shoth who has less than half its maximum hp can merge with any other shoth creature within 10 feet, adding its remaining hp to that creature’s. The hp gained this way can exceed the normal maximum of that creature. A shoth can accept one such merger every 24 hours.

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The sigilian can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: Cognivore
features.description: At the start of each of its turns if the sigilian is inside a book that is not a spellbook, it removes the words from 3 (1d6) pages and regains 7 (2d6) hp.

features.name: Home Sweet Tome
features.description: The sigilian can move half its speed to enter a book. If the book is being worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or the sigilian enters the book. A creature can take its action to find the sigilian in a book by succeeding on a DC 12 Intelligence (Investigation) check. If successful, a creature can use a bonus action to tear out the pages where the sigilian is hiding, forcing the sigilian out of the book and into an unoccupied space within 5 feet. Alternatively, a creature can destroy the book with a successful melee attack, dealing half of the damage to the sigilian and forcing it out of the book into an unoccupied space within 5 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sigilian makes three attacks: one with its cut and two with its paste.

actions.name: Cut
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage and the sigilian copies one of the target's weapon attacks for 1 minute.

actions.name: Paste
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: Damage die and type are determined by the copied weapon attack from Cut. Glowing runes in the image of that weapon appear as the sigilian attacks.

actions.name: Devour Spell
actions.description: While inside a spellbook, the sigilian eats one spell of the highest level present then exits the spellbook. It chooses to either make its next Paste attack with a number of damage dice equal to the eaten spell's level or regain 3 hp per spell level. The sigilian can only eat one spell at a time and must use the devoured spell's energy before attempting to enter another spellbook. The eaten spell's entry is garbled, but the owner can repair it for half the gold and time usually spent to copy a spell. If the owner has the spell prepared, it can re-record the spell during a long rest for no additional cost.

features.name: Nimble Feet
features.description: The kapi can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

features.name: Prehensile Tail
features.description: The kapi can use its tail to pick up or hold a small object that isn't being worn or carried. It can use its tail to interact with objects, leaving its hands free to wield weapons or carry heavier objects. The kapi can't use its tail to wield a weapon but can use it to trip an opponent (see below).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kapi makes two attacks: one with its quarterstaff and one with its tail trip.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Tail Trip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the Monkey King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The Monkey King has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Simian Affinity
features.description: The Monkey King can communicate with primates as if they shared a language. In addition, he can control primates with an Intelligence of 8 or lower that are within 120 feet of him.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Monkey King makes three golden staff attacks or two golden staff attacks and one tail attack.

actions.name: Golden Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Enlightened Ray
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 100 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) radiant damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Drunken Dodge
reactions.description: When the Monkey King is hit by a weapon attack, he gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of that turn.

legendary_actions.name: Great Leap
legendary_actions.description: The Monkey King moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Quick Staff
legendary_actions.description: The Monkey King makes a golden staff attack.

legendary_actions.name: Golden Burst (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each creature of the Monkey King’s choice within 10 feet of him must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Distract
features.description: As a bonus action, the vanara can use its tail to distract an opponent within 5 feet of it by pulling on an arm, tossing dirt in the target’s face, or some other method of interfering. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or have disadvantage on all attacks against the vanara until the vanara’s next turn.

features.name: Quadrupedal Dash
features.description: As a bonus action, the vanara can move up to 80 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. It can’t use this trait if it is wielding a weapon or holding an object weighing more than 10 lbs.

features.name: Standing Leap
features.description: The vanara’s long jump is 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or drop its weapon in a space within 10 feet of the target.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Howl (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The vanara releases a sonorous howl in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn’t deafened.

features.name: Flyby
features.description: The simurg doesn’t provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

features.name: Keen Sight
features.description: The simurg has advantage on Perception (Wisdom) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The simurg’s innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). The simurg can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect poison and disease, detect thoughts, spare the dying
2/day each: cure wounds, lesser restoration, purify food and drink
1/day each: greater restoration, remove curse

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The simurg makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Forceful Gale (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The simurg beats its wings, creating wind in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 10 feet away from the simurg and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t pushed or knocked prone.

name: Clacking Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can’t speak

features.name: Horrid Clacking
features.description: If the clacking skeleton moves at least 10 feet, each beast or humanoid within 30 feet of the skeleton that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The clacking skeleton makes two attacks: one with its glaive and one with its gore or two with its shortbow.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.  Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Monarch Skeleton
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silver
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Master Tactician
features.description: The monarch skeleton and any skeletons within 30 feet of it have advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the skeleton’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

features.name: Sovereign’s Command
features.description: As a bonus action, the monarch commands a skeleton within 30 feet of it to make one attack as a reaction against a creature the monarch attacked this round.

features.name: Turning Defiance
features.description: The monarch skeleton and any skeletons within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The monarch skeleton makes two dreadblade attacks.

actions.name: Dreadblade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

actions.name: Grasp of the Grave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each non-skeleton creature within 30 feet of the monarch must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by ghostly, skeletal hands for 1 minute. A restrained target takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature, including the target, can take its action to break the ghostly restraints by succeeding on a DC 16 Strength check.

name: Shadow Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can’t speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadow skeleton makes two scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Finger Darts
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is surrounded by a shadowy aura for 1 minute. While surrounded by the aura, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) necrotic damage when hit by the scimitar attack of a shadow skeleton. Any creature can take an action to extinguish the shadow with a successful DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana) check. The shadow also extinguishes if the target receives magical healing.

features.name: Flare
features.description: When immersed in magical darkness, a skull lantern emits a brilliant flash of light powerful enough to dispel magical darkness in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself, illuminating the area with bright light for 1d4 rounds. Afterwards, the light winks out and the skull falls to the ground, inert. In one week, the skull lantern has a 50% chance of becoming active again, though failure to do so means it will never reanimate.

features.name: Illumination
features.description: The skull lantern sheds bright light in a 20-foot‑radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.description: If damage reduces the skull to 0 hp, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the skull drops to 1 hp instead.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Beam (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The skull lantern opens its mouth, releasing a searing beam of light in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Heroic Leap (1/Day)
features.description: As a bonus action, the sleipnir can leap into the air, gaining a flying speed of 60 feet for 1 minute.

features.name: Trampling Charge
features.description: If the sleipnir moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a rune hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the sleipnir can make another rune hooves attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sleipnir makes two rune hooves attacks.

actions.name: Rune Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and 3 (1d6) radiant damage. An undead creature who takes damage from this attack must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be restrained by magical runes until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Gold and Ice (1/Day)
actions.description: The sleipnir summons a gilded avalanche in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 13 (3d8) bludgeoning and 13 (3d8) cold damage, is pushed 15 feet away from the sleipnir, and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone.

reactions.name: Eight Hooves (3/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature moves within 5 feet of the sleipnir, the sleipnir can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Foul Odor
features.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the giant sloth must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check.

features.name: Hunter's Dash
features.description: The giant sloth moves double its normal speed and has advantage on all of its attacks for 1 round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant sloth makes two attacks: one with its claw and one with its bite. If the giant sloth is grappling a creature, it can also use its Sloth's Embrace once.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the sloth doesn't have another creature grappled.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sloth's Embrace
actions.description: The giant sloth crushes a creature it is grappling by pulling the creature against its fetid, furry chest. The target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: The snow cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

features.name: Stalker
features.description: If the snow cat surprises a creature and hits it with a bite attack, the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature.

features.name: Snow Camouflage
features.description: The snow cat has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Spawn of Chernobog
languages: understands Common, Umbral, and Undercommon but can’t speak

features.name: Night’s Blood
features.description:
If a bite wound from the spawn of Chernobog results in an infection, the black oil that drips from the spawn’s jaws seeps into the wound and vanishes. After each long rest, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On two successes, the disease is cured. On a failure, the disease progresses, forcing the creature to undergo a series of changes, in the following order.
1. The creature can’t speak, and its tongue turns black.
2. The creature’s eyes turn a deep red, and it gains darkvision 60 feet and the Sunlight Sensitivity trait.
3. The creature secretes black oil from its skin, and it has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple. 
4. The creature’s veins turn black, slowly working their way up through the body from the appendages over 24 hours.
5. When the blackened veins reach its head after the final long rest, the creature experiences excruciating, stabbing pains in its temples. At sunset, the creature dies as the antlers of an elk burst from its head. The oil secreting from the corpse pools and forms a spawn of Chernobog at midnight.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the spawn of Chernobog has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
