actions.name: Paralyzing Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The retriever targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The paralyzed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the paralyzed creature is Medium or smaller, the retriever can pick it up as part of the retriever's move and walk or climb with it at full speed.

name: Frost Salamander
senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 14

features.name: Burning Fury
features.description: When the salamander takes fire damage, its Freezing Breath automatically recharges.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The salamander makes five attacks: four with its claws and one with its bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage and 5 (1d10) cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The salamander exhales chill wind in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Burden of Time
features.description: Beasts and humanoids, other than shadar-kai, have disadvantage on saving throws while within 10 feet of the gloom weaver.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: The gloom weaver has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description: The gloom weaver's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: arcane eye, mage armor, speak with dead 1/day each: arcane gate, bane, compulsion, confusion, true seeing

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The gloom weaver is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells: Cantrips (at will): chill touch (3d8 damage), eldritch blast (3 beams, +4 bonus to each damage roll), minor illusion, prestidigitation 1st- 5th level (3 5th-level slots): armor of Agathys, blight, darkness, dream, invisibility.fear, hypnotic pattern, major image, contact other plane, vampiric touch, witch bolt

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gloom weaver makes two spear attacks and casts one spell that takes 1 action to cast.

actions.name: Shadow Spear
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 26 (4d12) necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Misty Escape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.description: When the gloom weaver takes damage, it turns invisible and teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It remains invisible until the start of its next turn or until it attacks or casts a spell.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: The shadow dancer has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

features.name: Shadow jump
features.description: As a bonus action, the shadow dancer can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Both the space it teleports from and the space it teleports to must be in dim light or darkness. The shadow dancer can use this ability between the weapon attacks of another action it takes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shadow dancer makes three spiked chain attacks.

actions.name: Spiked Chain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or suffer one additional effect of the shadow dancer's choice: • The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the shadow dancer can't grapple another target. • The target is knocked prone. • The target takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: The soul monger has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The soul monger's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: chill touch (3d8 damage), poison spray (3d12 damage)
1/day each: bestow curse, chain lightning, finger of death, gaseous form, phantasmal killer, seeming

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The soul monger has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Soul Thirst
features.description: When the soul monger reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the soul monger can gain temporary hit points equal to half the creature's hit point maximum. While the soul monger has temporary hit points from this ability, it has advantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Weight of Ages
features.description: Any beast or humanoid, other than a shadar-kai, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the soul monger has its speed reduced by 20 feet until the start of that creature's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The soul monger makes two phantasmal dagger attacks.

actions.name: Phantasmal Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws until the start of the soul monger's next turn.

actions.name: Wave of Weariness (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The soul monger emits weariness in a 60-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 (10d8) psychic damage and suffers 1 level of exhaustion. On a successful save, it takes 22 (5d8) psychic damage.

features.name: Fallible Invisibility
features.description:
The skulk is invisible. This invisibility can be circumvented by three things:
• The skulk appears as a drab, smooth-skinned humanoid if its reflection can be seen in a mirror or on another surface.
• The skulk appears as a dim, translucent form in the light of a candle made of fat rendered from a corpse whose identity is unknown.
• Humanoid children, aged 10 and under, can see through this invisibility.

features.name: Trackless
features.description: The skulk leaves no tracks to indicate where it has been or where it's headed.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage. If the skulk has advantage on the attack roll, the target also takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

name: Skull Lord
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: all the languages it knew in life

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the skull lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Master of the Grave
features.description: While within 30 feet of the skull lord, any undead ally of the skull lord makes saving throws with advantage, and that ally regains 1d6 hit points whenever it starts its turn there.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: If the skull lord is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half the damage, the skull lord instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The skull lord is a 13th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The skull lord knows the following sorcerer spells:
Cantrips (at will): chill touch, fire bolt, mage hand, poison spray, ray of frost, shocking grasp
1st level (4 slots): magic missile, expeditious retreat, thunderwave
2nd level (3 slots): mirror image, scorching ray
3rd level (3 slots): fear, haste
4th level (3 slots): dimension door, ice storm
5th level (2 slots): cloudkill, cone of cold
6th level (1 slot): eyebite
7th level (1 slot): finger of death

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The skull lord makes three bone staff attacks.

actions.name: Bone Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Bone Staff (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The skull lord makes a bone staff attack.

legendary_actions.name: Cantrip
legendary_actions.description: The skull lord casts a cantrip.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The skull lord moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Summon Undead (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Up to five skeletons or zombies appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the skull lord and remain until destroyed. Undead summoned in this way roll initiative and act in the next available turn. The skull lord can have up to five undead summoned by this ability at a time.

name: The Angry
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

features.name: Two Heads
features.description: The Angry has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

features.name: Rising Anger
features.description:
If another creature deals damage to the Angry, the Angry's attack rolls have advantage until the end of its next turn, and the first time it hits with a hook attack on its next turn, the attack's target takes an extra 19 (3d12) psychic damage.
On its turn, the Angry has disadvantage on attack rolls if no other creature has dealt damage to it since the end of its last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Angry makes two hook attacks.

actions.name: Hook
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.

name: The Hungry
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

features.name: Life Hunger
features.description: If a creature the Hungry can see regains hit points, the Hungry gains two benefits until the end of its next turn: it has advantage on attack rolls, and its bite deals an extra 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Hungry makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. While grappling a creature, the Hungry can't attack with its claws.

name: The Lonely
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

features.name: Psychic Leech
features.description: At the start of each of the Lonely's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

features.name: Thrives on Company
features.description: The Lonely has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. It otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Lonely makes one harpoon arm attack and uses Sorrowful Embrace.

actions.name: Harpoon Arm
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The Lonely has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

actions.name: Sorrowful Embrace
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the Lonely must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. A creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, the Lonely pulls each creature grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

name: The Lost
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Lost makes two arm spike attacks.

actions.name: Arm Spike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Embrace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is frightened, and it takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns. The Lost can embrace only one creature at a time.

reactions.name: Tightening Embrace
reactions.description: If the Lost takes damage while it has a creature grappled, that creature takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

name: Wretched
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

features.name: Wretched Pack Tactics
features.description: The Wretched has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wretched's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated. The Wretched otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage, and the Wretched attaches to the target. While attached, the Wretched can't attack, and at the start of each of the Wretched's turns, the target takes 6 (1d10 + 1) necrotic damage. The attached Wretched moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the Wretched's movement. The Wretched can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach a Wretched.

features.name: Aura of Madness
features.description: Creatures within 20 feet of the grue that aren't aberrations have disadvantage on saving throws, as well as on attack rolls against creatures other than a star spawn grue.

actions.name: Confounding Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of the grue's next turn.

name: Star Spawn Hulk
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Psychic Mirror
features.description: If the hulk takes psychic damage, each creature within 10 feet of the hulk takes that damage instead; the hulk takes none of the damage. In addition, the hulk's thoughts and location can't be discerned by magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hulk makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target also takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the target's next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Reaping Arms (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hulk makes a separate slam attack against each creature within 10 feet of it. Each creature that is hit must also succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Star Spawn Larva Mage
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The larva mage's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: eldritch blast (3 beams, +3 bonus to each damage roll), minor illusion
3/day: dominate monster
1/day: circle of death

features.name: Return to Worms
features.description: When the larva mage is reduced to 0 hit points, it breaks apart into a swarm of insects in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the larva mage reforms from it 24 hours later.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Plague of Worms (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Each creature other than a star spawn within 10 feet of the larva mage must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and be blinded and restrained by masses of swarming worms. The affected creature takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of the larva mage's turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Feed on Weakness
reactions.description: When a creature within 20 feet of the larva mage fails a saving throw, the larva mage gains 10 temporary hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Cantrip (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The larva mage casts one cantrip.

legendary_actions.name: Slam (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The larva mage makes one slam attack.

legendary_actions.name: Feed (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each creature restrained by the larva mage's Plague of Worms takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage, and the larva mage gains 6 temporary hit points.

features.name: Ambush
features.description: On the first round of each combat, the mangler has advantage on attack rolls against a creature that hasn't taken a turn yet.

features.name: Shadow Stealth
features.description: While in dim light or darkness, the mangler can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mangler makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the attack roll has advantage, the target also takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Flurry of Claws (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The mangler makes six claw attacks against one target. Either before or after these attacks, it can move up to its speed as a bonus action without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Star Spawn Seer
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Out-of-Phase Movement
features.description: The seer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. Each creature it moves through takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage; no creature can take this damage more than once per turn. The seer takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The seer makes two comet staff attacks or uses Psychic Orb twice.

actions.name: Comet Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Orb
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 feet, one target. Hit: 27 (5d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Collapse Distance (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The seer warps space around a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. That creature must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, is magically teleported up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the seer can see, and all other creatures within 10 feet of the target's original space each takes 39 (6d12) psychic damage. On a successful save, the target takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.

reactions.name: Bend Space
reactions.description: When the seer would be hit by an attack, it teleports, exchanging positions with another star spawn it can see within 60 feet of it. The other star spawn is hit by the attack instead.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Extraordinary Leap
features.description: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to move 3 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Sticky Leg
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and grappled until it escapes (escape DC 12). The steeder can have only one creature grappled at a time.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Extraordinary Leap
features.description: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to jump 3 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Sticky Leg
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. Hit: The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and grappled until it escapes (escape DC 12). The steeder can have only one creature grappled at a time.

name: Steel Predator
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17
languages: understands Modron and the language of its owner but can't speak

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The steel predator's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. The steel predator can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
3/day each: dimension door (self only). plane shift (self only)

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The steel predator has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The steel predator's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The steel predator makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claw.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stunning Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The steel predator emits a roar in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (5d10) thunder damage, drops everything it's holding, and is stunned for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Stone Cursed
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Cunning Opportunist
features.description: The stone cursed has advantage on the attack rolls of opportunity attacks.

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While the stone cursed remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

actions.name: Petrifying Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage if the attack roll had advantage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, or it begins to turn to stone and is restrained until the end of its next turn, when it must repeat the saving throw. The effect ends if the second save is successful; otherwise the target is petrified for 24 hours.

name: Sword Wraith Commander
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Martial Fury
features.description: As a bonus action, the sword wraith can make one weapon attack, which deals an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage on a hit. If it does so, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Turning Defiance
features.description: The sword wraith and any other sword wraiths within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sword wraith makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Call to Honor (1/Day)
actions.description: To use this action, the sword wraith must have taken damage during the current combat. If the sword wraith can use this action, it gives itself advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, and 1d4 + 1 sword wraith warriors appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of it. The warriors last until they drop to 0 hit points, and they take their turns immediately after the commander's turn on the same initiative count.

name: Sword Wraith Warrior
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Martial Fury
features.description: As a bonus action, the sword wraith can make one weapon attack. If it does so, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

features.name: Hold Breath
features.description: The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.description: The tortle withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in its shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and can't increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, it can't take reactions, and the only action it can take is a bonus action to emerge.

features.name: Hold Breath
features.description: The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The tortle is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, guidance, produce flame
1st level (4 slots): animal friendship, cure wounds, speak with animals, thunderwave
2nd level (3 slots): darkvision, hold person

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.description: The tortle withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in its shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and can't increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, it can't take reactions, and the only action it can take is a bonus action to emerge.

name: Dire Troll
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell or sight.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, it regains only 5 hit points at the start of its next turn. The troll dies only if it is hit by an attack that deals 10 or more acid or fire damage while the troll has 0 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes five attacks: one with its bite and four with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind of Claws (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet of the troll must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Rancid Degeneration
features.description: At the end of each of the troll's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, unless the troll has taken acid or fire damage since the end of its last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

name: Spirit Troll
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.description: The troll can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes psychic or force damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The stunned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) psychic damage.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Poison Splash
features.description: When the troll takes damage of any type but psychic, each creature within 5 feet of the troll takes 9 (2d8) poison damage.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage, and the creature is poisoned until the start of the troll's next turn.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Venom Spray (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The troll slices itself with a claw, releasing a spray of poison in a 15-foot cube. The troll takes 7 (2d6) slashing damage (this damage can't be reduced in any way). Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Vampiric Mist
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Life Sense
features.description: The mist can sense the location of any creature within 60 feet of it, unless that creature's type is construct or undead.

features.name: Forbiddance
features.description: The mist can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

features.name: Misty Form
features.description: The mist can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can pass through it without squeezing. Each foot of movement in water costs it 2 extra feet, rather than 1 extra foot. The mist can't manipulate objects in any way that requires fingers or manual dexterity.

features.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
features.description: The mist takes 10 radiant damage whenever it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, the mist has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: The mist touches one creature in its space. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw (undead and constructs automatically succeed), or it takes 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage, the mist regains 10 hit points, and the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

name: Canoloth
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 19

features.name: Dimensional Lock
features.description: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the canoloth. Any attempt to do so is wasted.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The canoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The canoloth's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Uncanny Senses
features.description: The canoloth can't be surprised while it isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The canoloth makes two attacks: one with its tongue or its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15), pulled up to 30 feet toward the canoloth, and restrained until the grapple ends. The canoloth can grapple one target at a time with its tongue.

name: Dhergoloth
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The dhergoloth's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 10). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: darkness, fear
3/day: sleep

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The dhergoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The dhergoloth's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dhergoloth makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flailing Claws (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dhergoloth moves up to its walking speed in a straight line and targets each creature within 5 feet of it during its movement. Each target must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (3d12 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The dhergoloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Oinoloth
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The oinoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The oinoloth's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description: The oinoloth's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic, invisibility (self only) 1 /day each: feeblemind, globe of invulnerability, wall of fire, wall of ice

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oinoloth uses its Transfixing Gaze and makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bringer of Plagues (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: As a bonus action, the oinoloth blights the area within 30 feet of it. The blight lasts for 24 hours. While blighted, all normal plants in the area wither and die, and the number of hit points restored by a spell to a creature in that area is halved. Furthermore, when a creature moves into the blighted area or starts its turn there, that creature must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the oinoloth's Bringer of Plagues for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and is poisoned. The poisoned creature can't regain hit points. After every 24 hours that elapse, the poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). This reduction lasts until the poison ends, and the target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. The poison ends after the creature successfully saves against it three times.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupted Healing (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The oinoloth touches one willing creature within 5 feet of it. The target regains all its hit points. In addition, the oinoloth can end one disease on the target or remove one of the following conditions from it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The target then gains 1 level of exhaustion, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 7 (2d6). This reduction can be removed only by a wish spell or by casting greater restoration on the target three times within the same hour. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The oinoloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Transfixing Gaze
actions.description: The oinoloth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed until the end of the oinoloth's next turn. While charmed in this way, the target is restrained. If the target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the oinoloth's gaze for the next 24 hours.

name: Yagnoloth
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The yagnoloth's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic, invisibility (self only), suggestion
3/day: lightning bolt

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The yagnoloth's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yagnoloth makes one massive arm attack and one electrified touch attack, or it makes one massive arm attack and teleports before or after the attack.

actions.name: Electrified Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Massive Arm
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become stunned until the end of the yagnoloth's next turn.

actions.name: Life Leech
actions.description: The yagnoloth touches one incapacitated creature within 15 feet of it. The target takes 36 (7d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the yagnoloth gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest, and the target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Battlefield Cunning (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Up to two allied yugoloths within 60 feet of the yagnoloth that can hear it can use their reactions to make one melee attack each.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The yagnoloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

features.name: Ambush
features.description: During his first turn, the Servant has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn.

features.name: Craven
features.description: If the Servant starts his turn with 9 or less hit points, he must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, he becomes Frightened and must use his Dash or Disengage action to move away from any enemies. If movement is impossible, he will take the Dodge action instead.

actions.name: Broadsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) slashing damage.

features.name: Hunter
features.description: The Savage Hound doubles its Proficiency Bonus for all Wisdom (Perception) checks (included above).

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn't Incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

features.name: Ambush
features.description: During his first turn, Hunald has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn.

features.name: Ensorcelled
features.description: Hunald has been dominated by the will of the Nazgûl, and no words will cause him to stray from his mission (reflected in Condition Immunities, above).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Hunald makes three attacks with either his broadsword or great bow.

actions.name: Broadsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage. If Hunald uses one of his arrows from Angmar, it does an additional 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

features.name: Sunlight Curse
features.description: Stone-trolls become Petrified and turn into stone if they are touched by the bright light of the sun. If exposed to sunlight, the Stone-troll chief must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw at the beginning of its turn in order to find enough cover to avoid being turned to stone. On a failure, the Stone-troll becomes Petrified.

actions.name: Clobbering Sweep (1/day)
actions.description: The Stone-troll Chief can use his great size to strike multiple foes at once. He can make a melee attack against any number of targets within 5 feet, with a separate attack roll for each target. Targets must also make a DC 13 Dexterity check or be knocked Prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Stone-troll chief makes three attacks: two with his troll-club and one slam.

actions.name: Troll-club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Weighted Net
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 10/20 ft, one target. Hit: the target becomes Restrained. As an action, the restrained creature can make a DC 15 Strength check, escaping from the net on a success. The effect also ends if the net is destroyed. The netting has AC 10, 20 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage and immunity to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage.

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of him, Raegenhere suffers Disadvantage on his attack rolls.

features.name: Savage Assault
features.description: When Raegenhere rolls a natural 18 or 19, he may, as a bonus action, make a single additional melee attack against the same opponent.

features.name: Thing of Terror (1/day)
features.description: Raegenhere is an evil spirit wearing a living man like a suit of armour. He briefly shows his true form and each hero must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened of him until the end of his next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Raegenhere can make two attacks; one with his axe and one with his claws.

actions.name: Great Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Fell Spirit (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: When Raegenhere would be reduced to 0 hit points, he may use his reaction to add 10 (3d6) temporary hit points.

features.name: Echolocation
features.description: Valdis cannot use her blindsight while Deafened.

features.name: Enthrall
features.description: As a bonus action, Valdis (in her illusionary form) can force a creature within 60 ft to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become Charmed by her. A Miserable Charmed creature gains the Thrall ability, see The Thrall Curse, opposite page. The Charmed effect lasts until Valdis leaves the area, attacks the Charmed creature, or the creature takes a short rest.

features.name: Keen Hearing
features.description: Valdis has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

features.name: Fell Speed
features.description: Valdis may take a bonus action to Disengage from one opponent and engage another without provoking an opportunity attack. The new opponent must be within her regular movement rate.

features.name: Hard Eyed
features.description: Valdis has killed before, and will do so again. She scores a critical hit on any 18, 19 or 20 on an attack roll.

features.name: Hate Sunlight
features.description: Valdis despises the cleansing light of the Sun. If she is exposed to direct bright sunlight, she takes 3 (1d6) psychic damage each round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Valdis makes three attacks: Biting once and making two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or gain 1 Shadow point as the vampire feeds on their blood.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (2d4+4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bewilder
actions.description: Valdis can briefly assume the appearance of a beautiful woman. In this form, she can only use her Enthrall ability.

reactions.name: Snake-like Speed (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: Valdis is adept at avoiding injury and can use her reaction to halve the attack damage on an attack that she is aware of.

features.name: Leadership
features.description: As a bonus action, Girion can command a nearby Warrior to take his turn immediately after Girion's turn.

features.name: Savage Assault
features.description: When Girion rolls a natural 18 or 19 he may use his bonus action to make a single additional melee attack against the same opponent.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Girion makes three melee attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage if used with both hands.

damage_resistances: non-magical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing; cold, psychic

features.name: Deadly Voice
features.description: The Ringwraiths scream at their enemies with long-drawn wails that rise to a deafeningly high piercing note. The Lieutenant can use his bonus action to make a Frightened creature become Stunned until the end of his next turn.

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of him, the Ringwraith suffers Disadvantage on his attack rolls.

features.name: Gathering Shadows
features.description: If the Lieutenant of Dol Guldur is accompanied by either The Messenger of Mordor or The Ghost of the Forest, then the DC for saving throws against his abilities are raised by 1. If both accompany him, the DC is raised by 2.

features.name: Legendary
features.description: The Lieutenant can take one Legendary action each turn to use either his Black Breath, Claw or Thing of Terror abilities.

actions.name: Black Sword of Mordor
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) magical slashing damage. The Lieutenant can use his bonus action to add 5 (1d6+2) necrotic damage.

As long as the effect lasts, the Messenger may then make a melee attack against a Stunned creature as a bonus action. The Messenger can only use this ability once per long rest.

reactions.name: Dwimmerlaik

On a failure, the hero’s weapon shatters, and the hero receives the damage instead of the Ringwraith. Legendary weapons might not be destroyed, but are lost as a cold pain shoots through the hero’s body and she drops the weapon.

name: The Messenger of Mordor, Unclad and Invisible

features.name: Gathering Shadows

features.name: Thing of Shadow
features.description: The Ringwraith is Invisible.

actions.name: Black Breath
actions.description: The Ringwraith can use its action to target a creature within 10 feet. That creature must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature gains 1 Shadow point and becomes Unconscious (they may be revived by an action, but are Miserable until they take a long rest). On a success, the creature gains 1 Shadow point but remains awake. If a Ringwraith targets an Unconscious creature then they are subject to The Black Shadow (see page 127).

actions.name: Shadow of Fear
actions.description: The Ringwraith can direct its terrible will upon any Frightened mortal (Dwarf, Hobbit or Man) such that the victim becomes an agent for the Enemy. The Ringwraith may use its action to force the target to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, see The Shadow of Fear (page 128).

actions.name: Thing of Terror
actions.description: The Ringwraith can use his action to cause any number of targets within 60 feet of him to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail are Frightened until the end of the Ringwraith’s next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: +8 to hit, 1d4 + 4 damage

name: Ratatosk Commoner

The ratatosk’s spellcasting attribute is Charisma (save DC 14). They can innately cast the following spells without requiring material or somatic components:

• 1/day: mirror image

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The ratatosk assassin has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one other ratatosk is within 5 feet of the creature and the other ratatosk is not incapacitated.

features.name: Skitter

actions.name: Multiattack

On a failed save, the target takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and is poisoned. On a successful saving throw, the target takes half as much and is not poisoned. A poisoned target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.

actions.name: Gore

reactions.name: Nimble Reposition
reactions.description: When a creature the ratatosk assassin can see hits them with an attack, the assassin can move up to their normal movement without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Ratatosk Monk
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons

features.name: Ki Power
features.description: The ratatosk monk has a pool of martial power represented by 4 ki points. These points can be spent to activate their Martial Maneuvers.

features.name: Martial Maneuver
features.description:
Once per turn, when the ratatosk monk hits a target with their unarmed strike or gore attack, they can spend ki points to add one of the following effects to the attack. Unless indicated, each maneuver costs 1 ki point. Succeeding at the saving throw listed for a maneuver negates the effect but not the damage from the initial attack.
•	 Apprehensive. The target has disadvantage on all  attack rolls until the start of the monk's next turn (DC 14 Charisma).
•	 Confused. The target is affected as if by a confusion spell until the start of the monk's next turn (DC 14 Wisdom).
•	 Disarmed. An object, weapon, or item held by the target is knocked 10 feet away (DC 14 Strength).
•	 Knockdown. The target falls prone (DC 14 Dexterity).
•	 Stun (Costs 3 Ki Points). The target is stunned until the start of the monk's next turn. (DC 14 Constitution)

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While the ratatosk monk is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, their AC includes their Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ratatosk monk makes two unarmed attacks or one unarmed attack and one gore attack.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) psychic damage.

The target can add a d6 Command Die to its next roll, provided it can hear and understand the message. The condition lasts until the creature takes a long rest or an ally of the maiden attacks the Charmed creature.

features.name: Broken Blades
features.description: Ingomer may invoke this ability as a bonus action. He automatically scores a critical hit with all attacks this round. Afterwards, his weapon is destroyed.

features.name: Leadership
features.description: As a bonus action, Ingomer can command a nearby Warrior to act. That Warrior takes his turn immediately after Ingomer.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ingomer makes three attacks with his axe.

actions.name: Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10+3) slashing damage if wielded with both hands.

features.name: Far Traveller
features.description: If the Company is travelling with Gwina, she may be assigned a journey role.

features.name: Guided by the Stars
features.description: At the beginning of a journey if Gwina is allowed to spend time considering the night sky she gains Advantage on her first Journey Event check.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

name: Valdis of the line of Girion

features.name: Commanding
features.description: Allies of Valdis gain Advantage on attack rolls against enemies engaged with her.

features.name: Hard Eyed
features.description: Valdis has killed before, and will do so again. She scores a critical hit on any 18, 19 or 20 on an attack roll.

features.name: Hideous Toughness
features.description: Valdis can draw on her rage at being denied her birthright. She gains 10 (3d6) temporary hit points that last until the end of the fight if not removed by combat damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Valdis makes two attacks with her Broadsword.

actions.name: Broadsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage.

features.name: Call for Aid
features.description: Ceawin always has retainers ready to hand. He may use his action to summon 1d4 Warriors, who arrive in 1d6+1 rounds.

actions.name: Great Spear
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d12+2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Deadly Spear-Thrust
reactions.description: Ceawin may use his reaction to make a single melee attack against a creature that has just attacked him. If Ceawin inflicts a critical hit with this ability, the target is knocked Prone as the blow strikes a knee or other joint.

features.name: Bulky Armour
features.description: Mogdred has Disadvantage on all Dexterity checks.

features.name: Excessive Strength of Arms (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Mogdred can deliver a blow so powerful, or so penetratingly painful, that any opponent struck must make a DC 12 Dexterity save or fall Prone.

features.name: Fell Speed
features.description: Mogdred may take a bonus action to Disengage from one opponent and engage another without provoking an opportunity attack. The new opponent must be within his regular movement rate.

actions.name: Night-bringer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 10 (1d10+5) magical slashing damage or 11 (1d12+5) slashing damage if wielded with two hands. The target must also make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer 7 (2d6) necrotic damage as well.

reactions.name: Snake-like Speed (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: Mogdred is adept at avoiding injury and can use his reaction to halve the attack damage on an attack that he is aware of.

features.name: Bewilder
features.description: The Sorceress can briefly drop the glamour that is her mortal appearance, confusing all around her. All creatures within 30 feet of her must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be Stunned for 1d4+1 rounds. As long as the effect lasts, the Sorceress may make a melee attack against a Stunned creature as a bonus action. She can only use this ability once per long rest.

features.name: Iron Will
features.description: The Sorceress has no use for those who do not serve her ambitions. If the heroes have accrued any negative modifiers in an audience with her, the Final Audience check is made with Disadvantage.

features.name: Lordly Presence
features.description: Mortals that approach the Sorceress must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or become Charmed by her aura. Elves are immune to this effect. A hero remains Charmed until the Sorceress leaves the area, she attacks the Charmed creature, or another hero succeeds in a skill check to oppose her will.

actions.name: Gulrist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) magical slashing damage or 9 (1d12+3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands. The target must also make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer 7 (2d6) necrotic damage as well.

features.name: Hatred (Elves) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: The basilisk hates Elves and will attack them first. It can spend its bonus action to have Advantage on all attacks against them this round.

features.name: Tough Hide
features.description: The basilisk is resistant to non-magical bludgeoning and slashing damage.

actions.name: Putrescent Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned until they take a short rest.

actions.name: Venomous Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The basilisk can breathe out a cloud of poison in a 20 foot sphere. Each affected target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the target becomes Poisoned until it takes a short rest. On a failure, the target becomes Paralysed until it takes a short rest. Paralysed creatures must make another DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of their next turn. On a failure, the creature becomes Petrified until treated.

features.name: Camouflage
features.description: Gallows-weed has Advantage on all Dexterity (Stealth) checks in wooded terrain.

actions.name: Grasping Vines
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. Hit: If the Gallows-weed is not already grappling a creature, the target becomes Grappled (Escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target is Restrained. The Gallows-weed can spend its action to do 7 (1d4+5) bludgeoning damage to a creature that it already has Grappled.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The grim hawk has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn't Incapacitated.

features.name: Savage Assault
features.description: When a grim hawk rolls a natural 18 or 19 it may use its bonus action to make a single additional melee attack against the same opponent.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The grim hawk makes one attack with its beak and one attack with its claw.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Snake-like Speed (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: The grim hawk is adept at avoiding injury and can use its reaction to halve the attack damage on an attack that it is aware of.

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: Hill-men are fearful of fire. If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of them, the warrior suffers Disadvantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Strike Fear (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: As an action, the warrior may cause his eyes to flicker red with rage and he howls bestially to chill the hearts of his enemies. Each opponent within 30 ft of the warrior must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened until the end of the warrior's next turn.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage or 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Short Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

name: Spirit-warg
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from non-magical attacks

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: Spirit-wargs are fearful of fire. If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of them, the warg suffers Disadvantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Great Leap
features.description: The spirit-warg is capable of jumping huge distances. It may make a special Dash action to go twice its normal movement in a single jump. Any opponents in melee combat with the spirit-warg when it uses Great Leap get opportunity attacks as normal.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The spirit-warg has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn’t Incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

features.name: Dread Heirloom (1/Day)
features.description: Gorgol can spend his action to raise up The Scimitar of Azog in challenge. All Orc-kind in the battle gain Advantage until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Hatred (Dwarves) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Gorgol hates Dwarves and will attack them first. He can spend his bonus action to have Advantage on all attacks against them this round.

features.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharge after a short or long rest)
features.description: Gorgol can endure enormous damage. By spending an action brandishing the Scimitar of Azog, he gains a pool of 10 (3d6) temporary hit points that last till the end of the fight if not removed by combat damage.

features.name: Horrible Strength
features.description: If Gorgol makes a successful melee attack, he may use his bonus action to cause 3 additional damage of the same type to the target.

actions.name: The Scimitar of Azog
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) magical slashing damage. Two-handed.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Gorgol adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Gorgol must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

features.name: Bodyguards
features.description: Maghaz is always surrounded by lesser orcs whose duty it is to protect their leader. At least one other orc in his retinue gains the Thrall (Maghaz) special reaction ability (see page 137).

features.name: Bulky Armour
features.description: Maghaz has Disadvantage on Dexterity checks.

features.name: Coward
features.description: When injured, Maghaz suffers Disadvantage on all combat rolls.

features.name: Hate Sunlight
features.description: Maghaz despises the cleansing light of the Sun. If he is exposed to direct bright sunlight, he takes 3 (1d6) psychic damage each round.

features.name: Leadership
features.description: As a bonus action, Maghaz can command a nearby orc other than himself. That orc takes its turn immediately after Maghaz.

actions.name: Bent Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage or 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: Nagrhaw is fearful of fire. If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of it, the wolf suffers Disadvantage on his attack rolls. In addition, Nagrhaw is not able to use his Pack Tactics ability.

features.name: Hard Eyed
features.description: Nagrhaw is a killer without remorse. He scores a critical hit on a 18, 19 or 20 on his attack rolls.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The Wolf Leader has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wolf Leader’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

features.name: Savage Attack
features.description: When Nagrhaw scores a critical hit, he does an additional 5 (1d10) damage. This die is not doubled by the critical hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Nagrhaw makes two attacks: one bite and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 11 (1d12+5) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Commanding Voice
reactions.description: Nagrhaw promises pain and torment to his allies who do not follow his will. He may use his reaction when a non-hostile creature, that he can see within 30 feet, is about to make an attack roll or a saving throw. The target can add a d6 Command Die to that roll, provided it can hear and understand the message. A creature can benefit from only one Command Die at a time, and creatures that possess Commanding Voice cannot benefit from this effect.

features.name: Bulky Armour
features.description: The Greatest Goblin has Disadvantage on Dexterity checks.

features.name: Craven
features.description: If the Greatest Goblin starts his turn with 21 or less hit points, he must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, he is Frightened and must use his Dash or Disengage action to move away from any enemies. If movement is impossible, he will take the Dodge action instead.

features.name: Foul Liquor
features.description: The Greatest Goblin carries a flask of disgusting yet invigorating brew. As a bonus action he may take a swig, regaining 3 (1d6) hit points.

features.name: Gimlet Eyed
features.description: The Greatest Goblin inflicts +2 damage on all damage rolls made at night or underground (see below).

features.name: Hatred (Beornings) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: The Greatest Goblin loathes Beornings. He can use his bonus action to gain Advantage on attacks against them this round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Greatest Goblin makes two attacks with his hooked axe.

actions.name: Hooked Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) magical slashing damage or 10 (2d4+5) slashing damage at night or underground.

reactions.name: Disarming Parry
reactions.description: The Greatest Goblin can use his reaction to add +2 to his AC against one attack that he is aware of as long as he wields a melee weapon. If he uses his hooked axe then the attacker must make a DC 12 Strength check or become disarmed as the curved weapon snatches the weapon out of their hands.

features.name: Countless Children (Lair Action)
features.description: Sarqin’s spawn are never far away. She may use a lair action to summon 3 (1d6) Attercops, who arrive at the end of her next turn.

features.name: Fear Aura
features.description: Any creature hostile to Sarqin that starts its turn within 30 feet of her must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, unless she is Incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature’s saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to any Great Spider’s Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Legendary
features.description: Sarqin can take one legendary action each turn. She may use her Beak, Eightfold Gaze or Web as a legendary action.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: Sarqin can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Web Sense
features.description: While Sarqin is in contact with a web, she knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

features.name: Web Walker
features.description: Sarqin ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become Paralysed. A target make repeat the saving throw on their turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Eightfold Gaze
actions.description: Sarqin can take an action to select a target within 20 feet and force that creature to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains the Paralysed condition for 1d4 rounds. She may then use any of her attacks as a bonus action against the Paralysed target. If the creature passes the saving throw it is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

actions.name: Web
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/60 ft, one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The creature is Restrained by webbing. As an action, the Restrained creature can make a DC 13 Strength check, escaping from the webbing on a success. The effect also ends if the webbing is destroyed. The webbing has AC 10, 15 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage and immunity to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Beak
legendary_actions.description: Sarqin can take one legendary action each turn. She may use her Beak, Eightfold Gaze or Web as a legendary action.

legendary_actions.name: Eightfold Gaze
legendary_actions.description: Sarqin can take one legendary action each turn. She may use her Beak, Eightfold Gaze or Web as a legendary action.

legendary_actions.name: Web
legendary_actions.description: Sarqin can take one legendary action each turn. She may use her Beak, Eightfold Gaze or Web as a legendary action.

features.name: Camouflage
features.description: Tauler has Advantage on all Stealth checks in wooded terrain.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: Tauler can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be Paralysed until they complete a short rest. A target make repeat the saving throw on their turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. Hit: 26 (6d6+5) bludgeoning damage. The target must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be thrown 20 feet and knocked Prone.

actions.name: Terrorise
actions.description: Tauler targets up to three intelligent creatures he can see within 40 feet. Those targets must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened until the end of his next turn.

name: Black Tyulqin
senses: blindsight 30 ft, darkvision 60 ft, passive Perception 19

features.name: Legendary
features.description: Sarqin can take two legendary actions each turn. She may use her Beak, Ensnare, or Mesmerise abilities as legendary actions.

features.name: Many Poisons
features.description:
Tyulqin can use her bonus action to inject a poison when she successfully attacks with her beak. She may choose from the following effects:
• Crazed: The victim is temporarily affected by their next Shadow Weakness Flaw until they take a long rest.
• Despair: The victim is Miserable until they take a short rest.
• Distraught: The victim is Blinded and Deafened until they take a short rest.
• Weakened: The victim gains 2 (1d4) levels of Exhaustion.
• Sleep: The victim must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or become Unconscious.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: Tyulqin can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Web Sense
features.description: While Tyulqin is in contact with a web, she knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

features.name: Web Walker
features.description: Tyulqin ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

features.name: Webs of Illusion (1/day, Lair Action)
features.description: Tyulqin can enchant her webs to provide a vision that will deceive even Elven eyes. If she chooses to use this ability it must be on in the first round. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be Surprised.

features.name: Woven from Darkness (1/day, Lair Action)
features.description: Tyulqin can enchant her webs to absorb light itself, plunging everything within 30 ft around her into utter darkness. Non-magical light cannot penetrate the darkness, and creatures with darkvision cannot see into it. Magical light from any source can dispel the effect.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 14 (2d6+7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ensnare
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft, one target. Hit: The target has been caught by Tyulqin’s web-line and is Restrained (escape DC 17) by her web.

actions.name: Mesmerise
actions.description: Tyulqin may use her action and target one creature, who must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes Charmed until Tyulqin leaves the area or attacks the Charmed creature.

features.name: Camouflage
features.description: Forest Goblins have Advantage on all Stealth checks in wooded terrain.

features.name: Hate Sunlight
features.description: Forest Goblins despise the Sun. If it is exposed to direct bright sunlight, the goblin takes 3 (1d6) psychic damage each round.

features.name: Horrible Strength
features.description: If a Forest Goblin makes a successful melee attack, it may use its bonus action to cause 2 additional damage of the same type to the target.

features.name: Mirkwood Dweller (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: If there are any Mirkwood scenery features within 5 ft of the Forest Goblin it may use its bonus action to gain half cover. even if that scenery feature would not normally provide it.

actions.name: Jagged Knife
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stone Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage or 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
