If the Forest Goblin scores a critical hit, the stone head is destroyed in the process of doing the extra damage.

features.name: Camouflage
features.description: Hunter Spiders have Advantage on all Stealth checks in wooded terrain.

features.name: Great Leap
features.description: Hunter Spiders are capable of jumping huge distances. It may make a special Dash action to go twice its normal movement in a single jump. Any opponents in melee combat with the spider when it uses this ability get opportunity attacks as normal.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: Hunter Spiders can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned until they complete a short rest. A target may repeat the saving throw on their turn, ending the effect on a success.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The Marsh-dweller does not need to breathe underwater.

features.name: Foul Reek
features.description: The Marsh-dweller exudes such a horrid stink that, as a bonus action, it can force an opponent engaged in melee combat with it to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or acquire the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Biter
reactions.description: When attacked, the Marsh-dweller can use its reaction to make a single bite melee attack against its attacker. Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

features.name: Hatred (Elves) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Wild Men hate and fear Elves and will attack them first. The warrior can spend his bonus action to have Advantage on all attacks against them this round.

features.name: Mirkwood Dweller (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: If there are any Mirkwood scenery features within 5 ft of the warrior he may use his bonus action to gain half cover. even if that scenery feature would not normally provide it.

actions.name: Short Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stone Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage or 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the warrior scores a critical hit, the stone head is destroyed in the process of doing the extra damage.

reactions.name: Thrall (Spiders)
reactions.description: Wild Men are often the slaves of the Great Spiders. You may designate one spider as the warrior’s master. If the master is within the warrior’s movement speed, the warrior can use his reaction to become the target of an attack that would have hit his master. If the master is slain, the warrior flees the battlefield.

features.name: Denizen of the Dark
features.description: The Wood-wight is particularly adept at using the environment and shadows to its benefit. When it takes the Hide action, it makes a Dexterity (Stealth) check and any foes must make an opposed Wisdom (Perception) check to track its movements.

features.name: Stealthy
features.description: The Wood-wight may use its bonus action each round to Hide.

features.name: Wraith-like
features.description: The wight is a creature of shadow, sticks and bones animated by undying hatred. It has resistance to all non-magical weapon damage (see above).

actions.name: Horror of the Wood
actions.description: If encountered in Mirkwood, the Wood-wight can use its action to stir the evil forest to action. Tree limbs quiver and creak, leaves rustle with no wind, all manner of scurrying and slimy things scramble about, and the heroes feel the malevolence of the ancient wood. Each creature within 30 feet of the wight must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail are Frightened until the end of the Wood-wight’s next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Wood-wight makes three attacks with its strangling claws.

actions.name: Strangling Claws
actions.description: Melee Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) magical slashing damage.

features.name: Elven-hauberk
features.description: If Elrond ever went to war, he would wear the armour that he bore as Gil-galad's herald, a hauberk crafted by Damron the smith himself. It is so cunningly made that Elrond adds his full Dexterity modifier to his Armour Class.

features.name: Leader of Imladris (Lair Action)
features.description: If Elrond is near Rivendell, he may use a Lair Action to summon an Elf-Lord (Loremaster's Guide, page 77) to aid him. The Elf-Lord arrives at the end of Elrond's next turn.

features.name: Legendary
features.description: Elrond may take two legendary actions each turn. Each legendary action allows him to either use his Foresight ability without using his reaction, attack with his Spear of the Last Alliance or use his Hands of the Healer ability.

features.name: The Ring of Air
features.description: Elrond can use his bonus action to interact with something in the environment at range (for example an old tree might suddenly tumble down, or a stream temporarily swell to a torrent when an enemy crosses it) to create combat scenery. Or he may cloak an ally with the ring's magic. That ally gains a +4 bonus to their AC until the end of Elrond's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Elrond can make two attacks with his Spear of the Last Alliance.

actions.name: Spear of the Last Alliance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) piercing damage. On a hit, the Elf-Lord can use his bonus action to make another attack at another target within reach.

actions.name: Hands of the Healer
actions.description: In combat, Elrond can use his action to restore 8 (1d8+4) hit points to a creature within 5 feet of him. Outside of combat he can spend 10 minutes with a creature to remove a condition. He may also spend 10 minutes with a creature to restore all of its hit points. If he does so, he cannot use this ability again until he takes a short or long rest.

reactions.name: Foresight
reactions.description: Elrond is gifted with the ability to perceive much that is hidden from others. He may use his reaction to add 4 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. He does not need to see the attacker.

features.name: Elven-mail
features.description: Glorfindel wears a shirt of mail that was forged in Gondolin, for the wars of another Age.

features.name: Protector of Imladris (Lair Action)
features.description: If Glorfindel is within sight of Rivendell, he may regain 10 (3d6) hit points as a lair action.

features.name: Legendary
features.description: Glorfindel may take two legendary actions each turn. Each legendary action allows him to either use either his Parry or Light of the Blessed Realm abilities without using his reaction or attack with his Sword of the Eldar.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Glorfindel can make three attacks with his Sword of the Eldar.

actions.name: Sword of the Eldar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 11 (1d8+7) magical slashing damage or 12 (1d10+7) magical slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

reactions.name: Hallowed Servant
reactions.description: When Glorfindel would be reduced to 0 hit points by a damage source, he may use his reaction to add 21 (6d6) temporary hit points.

reactions.name: Light of the Blessed Realm
reactions.description: Within Glorfindel resides the power to defy the servants of the Enemy. When an enemy uses an ability that requires an action he may use his reaction to negate that ability.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Glorfindel adds 5 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

features.name: Trained Warhorse
features.description: In addition to the normal actions of a controlled mount, a rider may instruct Asfaloth to Charge or Attack with his Hooves.

features.name: Elven Steed
features.description: If a rider is forced to make any saving throw while mounted on Asfaloth, they automatically have Advantage on that saving throw. If Asfaloth is uncontrolled he will still follow the instructions of Glorfindel.

features.name: Trample
features.description: If Asfaloth moves at least 20 feet straight towards a creature and then successfully strikes that creature with his Hooves then the target must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone. If the target is knocked Prone then Asfaloth may use his bonus action to make another Hooves attack.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage. If Asfaloth bears a rider when he attacks, the rider must make a DC 5 Dexterity saving throw to remain mounted.

actions.name: Charge
actions.description: When Asfaloth takes this action, he gains additional movement equal to his speed. He must expend all of his movement this round. A rider that takes the Attack action this turn gains +4 to their damage rolls.

features.name: Hatred (Orc-kind) (Recharge 3-6)
features.description: Elrohir remembers the terrible fate that Orc-kind inflicted upon his mother. He will use his bonus action to gain Advantage on attacks against them this round.

features.name: Hawk’s Eye (Recharge 3-6)
features.description: Elrohir can use his bonus action to negate Disadvantage due to being at long range for this turn.

features.name: Many Long Leagues
features.description: If Elrohir is with the Company on a journey then a companion can spend Inspiration to allow a long rest. This ability can only be used once per journey.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Elrohir can make two attacks with either his Long Sword or his Great Bow.

actions.name: Long Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) slashing damage or 10 (1d10+5) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.description: If Elrohir can see an attacker that has struck him, he may use his reaction to halve that attack’s damage.

features.name: Hatred (Orc-kind) (Recharge 3-6)
features.description: Elladan will never forget his mother’s suffering at the hands of Orc-kind. He will use his bonus action to gain Advantage on attacks against them this round.

features.name: Hunter
features.description: Elladan gains +3 to all of his Perception checks (included above).

features.name: Well-travelled
features.description: If Elladan is with the Company and they are travelling in Eastern Eriador or the Western Vales then the Guide rolls 1d8+4 for the Embarkation Roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Elladan can make two attacks with either his Broadsword or his Great Bow.

actions.name: Broadsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 150/600 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Elladan adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

features.name: Two-weapon Attack
features.description: When Aiwiel makes a Dagger attack, she may use her bonus action to make a second Dagger attack, using the same to hit and damage values.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60, one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Song of Urgency
actions.description: Aiwiel may use her action to sing encouragement to her allies. Heroes that hear the song are moved to act with haste. A hero may use his reaction and spend Inspiration. Those that do gain +2 to AC, Advantage on Dexterity saving throws and an additional action on their turn. The action can only be used to Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object. The effect lasts until the end of Aiwiel’s next turn.

name: Arbarad

features.name: Deadly Names
features.description: Arbarad can spend his bonus action to add 3 (1d6) radiant damage to a servant of the Enemy that he has just struck in combat.

features.name: Hunter
features.description: Arbarad gains +2 to all of his Perception checks (included above).

features.name: Secret Places
features.description: If Arbarad is in the South Downs, the Weather Hills or the North Downs he always knows a place where the Company may take a long rest. It requires a successful Audience for Arbarad to lead them there, however.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Arbarad can make two attacks with either his Long Sword or his Great Bow.

actions.name: Long Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) slashing damage or 6 (1d10+1) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

source: The Regions of Eastern Eriador p.57

features.name: Long-pipe
features.description: Talandil can make a DC 15 Intelligence (Pipe) check as an action. On a success, he makes his next ability check with Advantage.

features.name: Many Long Leagues
features.description: If Talandil is with the Company on a journey then a companion can spend Inspiration to allow a long rest. This ability can only be used once per journey.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Talandil can make two attacks with his Long Sword.

actions.name: Long Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) slashing damage or 7 (1d10+2) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Talandil adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

features.name: Region-lore (Enedwaith)
features.description: If Kyna is with the Company for a journey that begins or ends in the Enedwaith or Tharbad, the Guide rolls 1d8+4 for the Embarkation Roll.

features.name: Hatred (Orc-kind) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Kyna and her folk hate Orcs and she will spend her bonus action to gain Advantage on attack rolls against them whenever she can.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 feet or range 20/60 feet, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage or 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 feet, one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage.

features.name: Secret Folk
features.description: If Bradan is making a roll to hide from others, to detect an ambush, discover a trap or discover treachery he has Advantage on the check. This will most commonly be applied to Insight, Investigation, Perception and Stealth checks.

actions.name: Short Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 feet, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Survivor
reactions.description: When outnumbered by his opponents, Bradan always uses the Dodge action. When an opponent misses him, he can make a single melee attack as a reaction.

features.name: Flyby
features.description: The crebain doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

features.name: Keen Sight
features.description: The crebain has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

features.name: Flyby
features.description: The crebain doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

features.name: Keen Sight
features.description: The crebain has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

features.name: Sunlight Curse
features.description: Stone-trolls become Petrified and turn into stone if they are touched by the bright light of the sun. Once the sun rises, a Stone-troll must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw at the beginning of its turn in order to find enough cover to avoid being turned to stone. On a failure, the Stone-troll becomes Petrified.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Stone-troll makes two attacks: one with its troll-club and one slam.

actions.name: Troll-club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

name: Goblin of Carn Dûm
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13

features.name: Craven
features.description: If the Goblin starts its turn with 6 or less hit points, it must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it becomes Frightened and must use its Dash or Disengage action to move away from any enemies. If movement is impossible, it will take the Dodge action instead.

features.name: Hate Sunlight
features.description: This creature despises the cleansing light of the Sun. If it is exposed to direct bright sunlight, it takes 3 (1d6) psychic damage each round.

features.name: Hatred (Dúnedain and High Elves) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: The Goblins of Carn Dûm both hate and fear those who defeated their master, the Dúnedain and the High Elves of Rivendell. A Goblin can use its bonus action to gain Advantage on attacks against them this round.

actions.name: Bent Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bow of Horn
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage. The victim must also make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

features.name: Hatred (Dúnedain) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Once, long ago, Rhudaur was under the dominion of the Dúnedain. While their hatred is centuries old, it has not grown cold. A Hill-man can use his bonus action to gain Advantage on any attack rolls against a Ranger this round.

features.name: Raven Spirits
features.description: Rumours say that when a Hill-man dies his spirit returns as a raven, to watch over his folk and spy on his dark master's foes. No one knows for certain if their sorcery is still so strong, but when the Hill-men are about, the ravens are never far away… When the first Hillman dies in combat, a flock of ravens swoops down on the battlefield. When this happens, all enemies of the Hill-men have Disadvantage on their attack rolls until the end of combat. Each raven has AC 12 and 1 hit point but they have no attacks and are so numerous that defeating them with weaponry is almost hopeless.

actions.name: Orc-axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage or 6 (1d8+2) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage or 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Curse of the Hill-men (1/day)
actions.description: The Hill-man can use his action to target a single hero who must then make a Corruption check, a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the hero loses Inspiration and gains a point of Shadow. On a success the hero still loses Inspiration. If the hero does not have Inspiration, they gain Disadvantage on their next ability check, attack roll or saving throw.

features.name: Hatred (Hobbits) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: The Orc can use its bonus action to gain Advantage on any attack rolls against a Hobbit this round.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the Orc has Disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Bent Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage or 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

features.name: Cruel Stroke (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: If Bloodstump has just hit with his Great Black Mace, he may spend his bonus action to turn the attack into a critical hit.

features.name: Hideous Toughness (Recharge after a short or long rest)
features.description: Bloodstump can endure enormous damage. He may spend an action to growl menacingly at his foes and then gain a pool of 10 (3d6) temporary hit points that last till the end of the fight if not removed by combat damage.

features.name: Horrible Strength
features.description: If Bloodstump makes a successful melee attack, he may use his bonus action to cause 5 additional damage of the same type to the target.

features.name: Hunter
features.description: Bloodstump doubles his Proficiency Bonus for all Wisdom (Perception) checks (included above).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Bloodstump makes two attacks: one bite and one strike with his mace.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 10 (2d4+5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Great Black Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 18 (2d12+5) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Great Leap
features.description: Dreorg is capable of jumping huge distances. He may make a special Dash action to go twice his normal movement in a single jump. Any opponents in melee combat with him when he uses Great Leap get Opportunity Attacks as normal.

features.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
features.description: Dreorg has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: Dreorg has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of his allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.

features.name: Savage Attack
features.description: When Dreorg scores a critical hit, he does an additional 5 (1d10) damage. This damage is not doubled by the critical hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Dreorg makes two attacks: one bite and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 11 (1d12+5) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Snake-like Speed (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: Dreorg is adept at avoiding injury and can use his reaction to halve the attack damage on an attack that he is aware of.

features.name: Hatred (Dwarves) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Rine detests Dwarves. She can use her bonus action to gain Advantage on attacks against them this round.

features.name: Suit of Armour
features.description: Rine has Advantage on her Dexterity saving throws due to her Sunlight Curse as most of her body is shielded from the sun by her armour.

features.name: Sunlight Curse
features.description: Stone-trolls become Petrified and turn into stone if they are touched by the bright light of the sun. Once the sun rises, Rine must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw at the beginning of her turn in order to find enough cover to avoid being turned to stone. On a failure, she becomes Petrified.

features.name: Weak Spot
features.description: If Rine uses a special ability that uses an action (her Smashing Blow), any heroes that are within range may use their reaction to make a single attack. For this attack only, Rine is considered vulnerable to Piercing, Slashing and Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Rine makes two attacks with her Troll-club.

actions.name: Troll-club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Smashing Blow
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 15 (2d18+6) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw or become Prone. Miss: the target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or become Prone.

features.name: Hatred (Hobbits) (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Radgul can use his bonus action to gain Advantage on any attack rolls against a Hobbit this round.

features.name: Horrible Strength
features.description: If Radgul makes a successful melee attack, he may use his bonus action to cause 3 additional damage of the same type to the target.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, Radgul has Disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Orcish Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage or 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Commanding Voice
reactions.description: Radgul can inspire his allies with his sly words and half-empty promises. He may use his reaction to utter a command or shout a warning whenever a non-hostile creature, that he can see within 30 feet, is about to make an attack roll or a saving throw. The target can add a d6 Command Die to that roll, provided it can hear and understand the message. A creature can benefit from only one Command Die at a time and creatures that possess Commanding Voice cannot benefit from this effect.

features.name: Denizen of the Dark
features.description: The Barrow-wight is particularly adept at using the environment and shadows to its benefit. It may take the Hide action, even in plain sight. It makes a Dexterity (Stealth) check and any foes must make an opposed Wisdom (Perception) check to track its movements.

features.name: Fell Spirit (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: When the Barrow-wight would be reduced to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to add 7 (2d6) temporary hit points.

features.name: Hate Sunlight
features.description: The Barrow-wight despises the cleansing light of the Sun. If it is exposed to direct bright sunlight, it takes 3 (1d6) psychic damage each round.

actions.name: Ancient Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Chilling Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Stunned until the end of the Barrow-wight's next turn. If the target is already Stunned then the target becomes Unconscious until it completes a short rest instead. Unconscious companions are dragged into the wight's barrow to be sacrificed; if found in time, they may be roused with a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

actions.name: Wight Song (1/day)
actions.description: Barrow-wights chant a low, chilling song to subdue their foes with the dark enchantment of their voice. Each creature within 60 feet of the Barrow-wight must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. Creatures that fail the saving throw are Stunned. A Stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the beginning of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.description: If damage reduces the Bog Soldier to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the Bog Soldier drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Short Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Grasping Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: the target is Grappled (Escape DC 11) and the Bog Soldier can spend an action to drag the character into the deepest part of the muck… see the Bog combat scenery entry on page 91 of the Loremaster's Guide.

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of it, the Fell Wraith suffers Disadvantage on its attack rolls.

features.name: Unnatural Vitality
features.description: The Fell Wraith can use its bonus action to regain 6 (1d12) hit points. It cannot use this ability to exceed its normal hit point maximum.

features.name: Wraith-like
features.description: The Fell Wraith has resistance to all non-magical weapon damage and its base Armour Class is equal to 10 plus twice its Dexterity modifier.

actions.name: Broadsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage or 5 (1d6+1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Strike Fear (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: As an action, the Fell Wraith may force each opponent within 30 ft to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened until the end of the the Wraith's next turn.

features.name: Black Dread
features.description: When forced to make a Wisdom saving throw against this creature targets automatically have Disadvantage on the roll.

features.name: Ghost-form
features.description: This creature is insubstantial and cannot be easily hurt by normal means. See the damage and condition resistances and immunities above.

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.description: The creature can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Grieve (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: As an action, the creature may force each opponent within 30 ft to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw (with Disadvantage, see above) or experience a harrowing sorrow, causing him to gain 3 (1d4+1) Shadow points. If the target rolls a 1 on the saving throw, the target is also Stunned until the end of the Spectre’s next turn.

actions.name: Visions of Torment
actions.description: As an action, the creature can force one target within 60 feet to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw (with Disadvantage, see above) or take psychic damage equal to 2 (1d4) plus its total Shadow score.

features.name: Barrow of the Dead (Lair action, Recharge 6)
features.description: If the Wight-king is in the Barrow-downs, he may use a Lair action to call the evil spirits of Tyrn Gorthad to him: 3 (1d4+1) Barrow-wights arrive at the end of his next turn.

features.name: Denizen of the Dark
features.description: The Wight-king is particularly adept at using the environment and shadows to its benefit. He may take the Hide action, even in plain sight. He makes a Dexterity (Stealth) check and any foes must make an opposed Wisdom (Perception) check to track his movements.

features.name: Hate Sunlight
features.description: The Wight-king despises the cleansing light of the Sun. If he is exposed to direct bright sunlight, he takes 3 (1d6) psychic damage each round.

features.name: Unnatural Vitality
features.description: The Wight-king can use his bonus action to regain 6 (1d12) hit points. He cannot use this ability to exceed his normal hit point maximum.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Wight-king makes an attack with his sword and his Chilling Touch.

actions.name: Ancient Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Chilling Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become Stunned until the end of the Wight-king’s next turn. If the target is already Stunned then the target becomes Unconscious until it completes a short rest instead. Unconscious companions are dragged into the Wight-king’s barrow to be sacrificed; if found in time, they may be roused with a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

actions.name: Darker than the Darkness (1/day)
actions.description: The Wight-king can spend his action to summon a supernatural darkness. It is centred on the wight and extends out to a radius of 15 feet. Torches and other non-magical light sources do not pierce the darkness. A magical light can counter the darkness effect but does not dispel it. The darkness lasts until the Wight-king is slain or he spends a bonus action to cancel the effect.

actions.name: Wight-king Song (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The King chants a low, chilling song to subdue his foes with the dark enchantment of his voice. Each creature within 60 feet of the Wight-king must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. Creatures that fail the saving throw are Stunned. A Stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the beginning of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

name: The Lord of the Nazgûl, Unclad and Invisible
damage_immunities: non-magical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing; cold, psychic

features.name: The Black Captain
features.description: The Nazgûl are fearsome opponents, but they are made even more formidable when encountered together with their Chieftain. If the Lord is accompanied by one or more Nazgûl, a target forced by any Ringwraith to make a saving throw makes that roll at Disadvantage.

features.name: Legendary
features.description: The Lord can take two Legendary actions each turn to use either his Black Breath, Spell of Prohibition or Thing of Terror abilities.

features.name: Thing of Shadow
features.description: The Ringwraith is Invisible.

actions.name: Black Breath
actions.description: The Lord can use his action to target a creature within 10 feet. That creature must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature gains 1 Shadow point and becomes Unconscious. The creature may be revived as an action, but is Miserable until it takes a long rest. On a success, the creature gains 1 Shadow point but remains awake. If a Ringwraith targets an Unconscious creature then it is subject to The Black Shadow (see page 75).

actions.name: Shadow of Fear
actions.description: The Lord can direct its terrible will upon any Frightened mortal (Dwarf, Hobbit or Man) such that the victim becomes an agent for the Enemy. The Ringwraith may use its action to force the target to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, see The Shadow of Fear (page 74).

actions.name: Spell of Prohibition
actions.description: The Lord can use his action to force one creature within 30 feet to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target is Stunned until the end of the Ringwraith’s next turn and drops any items that it is carrying.

actions.name: Thing of Terror
actions.description: The Lord can use his action to cause any number of targets within 60 feet of him to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail are Frightened until the end of the Ringwraith’s next turn.

name: The Lord of the Nazgûl as Dark Undead
damage_resistances: non-magical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing; cold, psychic

features.name: The Black Captain
features.description: The Nazgûl are fearsome opponents, but they are made even more formidable when encountered together with their Chieftain. If the Lord is accompanied by one or more Nazgûl, a target forced by any Ringwraith to make a saving throw makes that roll at Disadvantage.

features.name: Deadly Voice
features.description: The Ringwraiths scream at their enemies with long-drawn wails that rise to a deafeningly high piercing note. The Lord can use his bonus action to make a Frightened creature become Stunned until the end of the Lord’s next turn.

features.name: Fear of Fire
features.description: If a torch or other flame comes within 10 feet of him, the Lord suffers Disadvantage on his attack rolls.

features.name: Legendary
features.description: The Lord can take two Legendary actions each turn to use either his Black Breath, Spell of Prohibition or Thing of Terror abilities.

features.name: Unyielding (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: The Lord can use his bonus action to gain 10 temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Lord makes one attack with his Black Sword and one with his Morgul-knife or Claw.

actions.name: Black Sword of Mordor
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage. The Ringwraith can use his bonus action to add 5 (1d6+2) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Morgul-knife
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 6 (1d4+4) piercing damage and see Morgul-knives, page 88.

actions.name: Black Breath
actions.description: The Lord can use his action to target a creature within 10 feet. That creature must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature gains 1 Shadow point and becomes Unconscious. They may be revived as an action, but are Miserable until it takes a long rest. On a success, the creature gains 1 Shadow point but remains awake. If a Ringwraith targets an Unconscious creature then it is subject to The Black Shadow (see page 75).

actions.name: Shadow of Fear
actions.description: The Lord can direct its terrible will upon any Frightened mortal (Dwarf, Hobbit or Man) such that the victim becomes an agent for the Enemy. The Ringwraith may use its action to force the target to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, see The Shadow of Fear (page 74).

actions.name: Spell of Prohibition
actions.description: The Lord can use his action to force one creature within 30 feet to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target is Stunned until the end of the Ringwraith’s next turn and drops any items that they are carrying.

actions.name: Thing of Terror
actions.description: The Lord can use his action to cause any number of targets within 60 feet of him to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail are Frightened until the end of the Ringwraith’s next turn.

reactions.name: Dwimmerlaik
reactions.description: If a hero strikes the Lord with a critical hit, he may use his reaction to invoke this ability. The hero must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the hero’s weapon shatters, and the hero receives the damage instead of the Ringwraith. Legendary weapons might not be destroyed, but are lost as a cold pain shoots through the hero’s body and she drops the weapon.

name: Mend-nets

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The tribal warrior has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the warrior's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

source: Rise of Tiamat p.90 (tribal warrior stat block)

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing damage.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The toad can breathe air and water.

features.name: Cold Aura
features.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the toad takes 3 (1d6) cold damage.

features.name: Standing Leap
features.description: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the toad can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The toad makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad, and it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

features.name: Earth Glide
features.description: The dao can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dao doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

features.name: Elemental Demise
features.description: If the dao dies, its body disintegrates into crystalline powder, leaving behind only equipment it was wearing or carrying.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The dao's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, stone shape
3/day each: passwall, move earth, tongues
1/day each: conjure elemental (earth elemental only), gaseous form, invisibility, phantasmal killer, plane shift, wall of stone

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dao makes two fist attacks or two maul attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6+6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Strength check or be knocked prone.

name: Dragonfang
damage_resistances: one of the following: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison

features.name: Dragon Fanatic
features.description: The dragonfang has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. While the dragonfang can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonfang ignores the effects of being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Fanatic Advantage
features.description: Once per turn, if the dragonfang makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

features.name: Limited Flight
features.description: The dragonfang can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The dragonfang has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonfang’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragonfang attacks twice with its shortsword.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (ld6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) damage of the type to which the dragonfang has damage resistance.

actions.name: Orb of Dragon’s Breath (2/Day)
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) damage of the type to which the dragonfang has damage resistance.

name: Dragonsoul
damage_resistances: one of the following: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison

features.name: Dragon Fanatic
features.description: The dragonsoul has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. While the dragonsoul can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonsoul ignores the effects of being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Fanatic Advantage
features.description: Once per turn, if the dragonsoul makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

features.name: Limited Flight
features.description: The dragonsoul can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The dragonsoul has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonsoul's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragonsoul attacks twice with its shortsword.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (ld6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) damage of the type to which the dragonsoul has damage resistance.

actions.name: Orb of Dragon's Breath (3/Day)
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) damage of the type to which the dragonsoul has damage resistance.

name: Dragonwing
damage_resistances: one of the following: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison

features.name: Dragon Fanatic
features.description: The dragonwing has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. While the dragonwing can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonwing ignores the effects of being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Fanatical Advantage
features.description: Once per turn, if the dragonwing makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

features.name: Limited Flight
features.description: The dragonwing can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The dragonwing has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonwing’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragonwing attacks twice with its scimitar.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (ld6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (ld6) damage of the type to which the cultist has damage resistance.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The toad can breathe air and water.

features.name: Cold Aura
features.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the toad takes 3 (ld6) cold damage.

features.name: Standing Leap
features.description: The toad’s long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (ld8 + 1) piercing damage plus 4 (ld8) cold damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the toad can't bite another target.

name: Naergoth Bladelord
damage_resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, Naergoth has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Naergoth makes three attacks, either with his longsword or longbow. He can use Life Drain in place of one longsword attack.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a

features.name: Draconic Majesty
features.description: Neronvain adds his Charisma bonus to his AC (included).

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Magic can't put Neronvain to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Neronvain makes two attacks, either with his shortsword or Eldritch Arrow.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Arrow
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) force damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Poisonous Cloud (2/Day)
actions.description: Poison gas fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Neronvain can see within 50 feet of him. The gas spreads around corners and remains until the start of Neronvain's next turn. Each creature that starts its turn in the gas must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Severin
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Severin has the Mask of the Dragon Queen.

features.name: Draconic Majesty
features.description: Severin adds his Charisma bonus to his AC (included).

features.name: Ignite Enemy
features.description: If Severin deals fire damage to a creature while wearing the Mask of the Dragon Queen, the target catches fire. At the start of each of its turns, the burning target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. A creature within reach of the fire can use an action to extinguish it.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
features.description: While wearing the Mask of the Dragon Queen, if Severin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Illusory Self (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
features.description: When a creature Rath can see makes an attack roll against him, he can interpose an illusory duplicate between the attacker and himself. The attack automatically misses Rath, then the illusion dissipates.

actions.name: Burning Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Flaming Orb
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (9d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Scorching Burst
actions.description: Severin chooses a point he can see within 60 feet of him. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: Severin makes one attack.

legendary_actions.name: Fiery Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Severin, along with any objects he is wearing or carrying, teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Each creature within 5 feet of Severin before he teleports takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

legendary_actions.name: Hellish Chains (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Severin targets one creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target is wrapped in magical chains of fire and restrained. The restrained target takes 21 (6d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of its turns, the target can make a DC 17 Strength saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Tiamat
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
senses: darkvision 240 ft., truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 36

features.name: Discorporation
features.description: When Tiamat drops to 0 hit points or dies, her body is destroyed but her essence travels back to her domain in the Nine Hells, and she is unable to take physical form for a time.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting (3/Day)
features.description: Tiamat can innately cast divine word (spell save DC 26). Her spellcasting ability is Charisma.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
features.description: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Limited Magic Immunity
features.description: Unless she wishes to be affected, Tiamat is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: Tiamat's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Multiple Heads
features.description: Tiamat can take one reaction per turn, rather than only one per round. She also has advantage on saving throws against being knocked unconscious. If she fails a saving throw against an effect that would stun a creature, one of her unspent legendary actions is spent.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: Tiamat regains 30 hit points at the start of her turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tiamat can use her Frightful Presence. She then makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her tail.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage.

features.name: Siege Monster
features.description: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

features.name: Treespeech
features.description: A weeping treant can converse with plants, and most plants greet them with a friendly or helpful attitude.

features.name: Acidic Tears
features.description: Thick tears of dark sap stream continuously down the treant's face and trunk. These tears are highly acidic—anyone who attacks the treant from a range of 5 feet or less must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 6 (1d12) acid damage from splashed tears. This acidic matter continues doing 6 (1d12) acid damage at the start of each of the creature's turns until it or an adjacent ally uses an action to wipe off the tears or three rounds elapse.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes three slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., single target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Blinding Beauty
features.description: All creatures within 30 feet of a shadow nymph who look directly at her must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be blinded permanently. A creature can avoid this effect for one full round by choosing to avert its eyes at the start of its turn, but it then has disadvantage on any attacks or other rolls directed against the shadow nymph until the start of its next turn. A shadow nymph can suppress or resume this ability as a bonus action. Anyone who successfully saves against this effect cannot be affected by it from the same shadow nymph for 24 hours.

name: Mirror Shard (object)
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 15

features.name: Damage Threshold
features.description: The mirror shard has a damage threshold of 20. If it takes damage from a single source that is less than 20, it takes no damage.

features.name: Quasi-Intelligence
features.description: The mirror shard has a spark of quasi-intelligence. Its primary goal is to be rejoined with the Dusk Queen's mirror. A shard continually urges any PC possessing it to take it to the Queen's Tower. If a PC attempts to damage a mirror shard, remove it from the forest, or do anything else contrary to the shard's goal, it attempts to force the PC into compliance (DC 11 Wisdom saving throw to resist).

name: Gothrolg
senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

features.name: Brute
features.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Gothrolg hits with it (included in the attack).

features.name: Indominable Heart
features.description: Gothrolg has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, or put to sleep.

features.name: Surprise Attack
features.description: If Gothrolg surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gothrolg makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage in melee or 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage at range.

actions.name: Necrotic Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Gothrolg exhales a burst of withering energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Shadow Blend
features.description: In areas of dim light or darkness, an elder shadow drake is treated as invisible. Artificial illumination, such as a lantern or a light or continual flame spell, does not negate this ability; nothing less than true sunlight or a daylight spell does. The drake cannot use its Speed Surge or its Stygian Breath while invisible. An elder shadow drake can suspend or resume this ability at will, so long as the drake is in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Shadow Jump
features.description: An elder shadow drake can travel between shadows as if by means of a dimension door spell. This magical transport must begin and end in an area of dim light or darkness, and the distance must be no more than 60 feet.

features.name: Speed Surge
features.description: The elder shadow drake takes one additional move action on its turn. It can use only one speed surge per round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drake makes one bite attack and one tail slap attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stygian Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The elder shadow drake exhales a ball of black liquid that travels up to 60 feet before exploding into a cloud of frigid black mist with a 20-foot radius. Each creature in that sphere takes 42 (12d6) cold damage, or half damage with a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. Within the area of effect, the mist snuffs out nonmagical light sources and dispels magical light of 1st level or lower.

name: Aazael, the Dread Knight
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Aazael has +1 plate, a +1 ring of protection, and a +1 glaive.

features.name: Fear Aura
features.description: Any creature hostile to Aazael that starts its turn within 20 feet of the dread knight must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, unless Aazael is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature’s saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to Aazael’s fear aura for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Aazael has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Rejuvenation
features.description: One day after Aazael is destroyed, his armor begins to rebuild the undead body trapped within. This process takes 1d10 days—if the body is destroyed before that time passes, the armor merely starts the process anew. After this time has elapsed, Aazael wakens fully healed (see sidebar for more information).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Aazael is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following paladin spells prepared:
1st level (4 slots): command, compelled duel
2nd level (3 slots): aid, magic weapon
3rd level (2 slots): dispel magic, elemental weapon

features.name: Undead Nature
features.description: Aazael doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Aazael makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: +1 Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Summon Pet (1/Day)
actions.description: Aazael may summon Annominc, his fiendish black panther servant (see sidebar), which immediately appears adjacent to him. Annominc remains for 1 hour, until it or Aazael dies, or until Aazael dismisses it as an action.

name: The Dusk Queen
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that aren’t cold iron
senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: The Dusk Queen has scrolls of darkness (x2), dominate person, freedom of movement*, harm, mage armor*, protection from energy (×2)*, see invisibility, shield, slow, stoneskin, and true seeing*, a handy haversack, and a ring of feather falling (those marked with * indicate spells cast before combat begins).

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: The Dusk Queen has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put her to sleep.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The Dusk Queen’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. She can cast the following spells innately, requiring no material components.
3/day: misty step (when in shadows, dim light, or darkness)

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the Dusk Queen has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Arcane Spellcasting
features.description:
The Dusk Queen is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her arcane spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She knows the following wizard spells:
Cantrips (4 slots): chill touch, control flames, minor illusion, ray of frost
1st level (4 slots): color spray, ray of sickness, protection from evil and good, witch bolt
2nd level (3 slots): blindness/deafness, cloud of daggers, enlarge/reduce
3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, dispel magic, major image
4th level (1 slot): phantasmal killer

features.name: Divine Spellcasting
features.description:
The Dusk Queen is a 7th-level divine spellcaster. Her divine spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She knows the following cleric spells:
Cantrips (4 slots): guidance, mending, resistance
1st level (4 slots): bane, guiding bolt, sanctuary
2nd level (3 slots): enhance ability, hold person, silence
3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, meld into stone, protection from energy
4th level (1 slot): stone shape

features.name: Traveler in Darkness
features.description: The Dusk Queen has advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to know about shadow roads and shadow magic spells or items.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The panther has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Pounce
features.description: If the panther moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the panther can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

features.name: Poor Depth Perception
features.description: The cyclops has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cyclops makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

name: Deep Scion
speed: 30 ft. (20 ft. and swim 40 ft. in hybrid form)

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The deep scion can use its action to polymorph into a humanoid-piscine hybrid form, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. The deep scion reverts to its true form if it dies.

features.name: Amphibious (Hybrid Form Only)
features.description: The deep scion can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: In humanoid form, the deep scion makes two melee attacks. In hybrid form, the deep scion makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Battleaxe (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Bite (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Psychic Screech (Hybrid Form Only; Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The deep scion emits a terrible scream audible within 300 feet. Creatures within 30 feet of the deep scion must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of the deep scion’s next turn. In water, the psychic screech also telepathically transmits the deep scion’s memories of the last 24 hours to its master, regardless of distance, so long as it and its master are in the same body of water.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The conjurer is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The conjurer has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): acid splash,* mage hand,* poison spray,* prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): mage armor, magic missile, unseen servant*
2nd level (3 slots): cloud of daggers,* misty step,* web*
3rd level (3 slots): fireball, stinking cloud*
4th level (3 slots): Evard’s black tentacles,* stoneskin
5th level (2 slots): cloudkill,* conjure elemental*
*Conjuration spell of 1st level or higher

features.name: Benign Transportation (Recharges after the Conjurer Casts a Conjuration Spell of 1st Level or Higher)
features.description: As a bonus action, the conjurer teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see. If it instead chooses a space within range that is occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature, they both teleport, swapping places.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The nereid can breathe air and water.

features.name: Aquatic Invisibility
features.description: If immersed in water, the nereid can make itself invisible as a bonus action. It remains invisible until it leaves the water, ends the invisibility as a bonus action, or dies.

features.name: Mantle Dependent
features.description: The nereid wears a mantle of silky cloth the color of sea foam, which holds the creature’s spirit. The mantle has an AC and hit points equal to that of the nereid, but the garment can’t be directly harmed while the nereid wears it. If the mantle is destroyed, the nereid becomes poisoned and dies within 1 hour. A nereid is willing to do anything in its power to recover the mantle if it is stolen, including serving the thief.

features.name: Shape Water
features.description: The nereid can cast control water at will, requiring no components. Its spellcasting ability for it is Charisma. This use of the spell has a range of 30 feet and can affect a cube of water no larger than 30 feet on a side.

features.name: Speak with Animals
features.description: The nereid can comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts.

actions.name: Blinding Acid
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) acid damage, and the target is blinded until the start of the nereid’s next turn.

actions.name: Drowning Kiss (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The nereid touches one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (3d12 + 3) acid damage. On a failure, it also runs out of breath and can’t speak for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Water Lash
actions.description: The nereid causes a 5-foot cube of water within 60 feet of it to take a shape of its choice and strike one target it can see within 5 feet of that water. The target must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and if it is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 15 feet in a straight line or is knocked prone (nereid’s choice). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn’t pushed or knocked prone.

name: Sea Spawn
languages: understands Aquan and Common but can't speak

features.name: Limited Amphibiousness
features.description: The sea spawn can breathe air and water, but needs to be submerged in the sea at least once a day for 1 minute to avoid suffocating.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sea spawn makes three attacks: two unarmed strikes and one with its Piscine Anatomy.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Piscine Anatomy
actions.description:
The sea spawn has one or more of the following attack options, provided it has the appropriate anatomy:
	 Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
	 Poison Quills. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
	 Tentacle. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the sea spawn can't use this tentacle on another target.

speed: 30 ft. (fly 50 ft. in raven and hybrid forms)

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The wereraven can use its action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid or into a raven, or back into its human form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its human form if it dies.

features.name: Mimicry
features.description: The wereraven can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack (Human or Hybrid Form Only)

The mouth screams for 8 rounds in total. For each 2 rounds that pass, the hermit's screaming summons an awakened tree, which drags itself from the edges of the lake nearby to attack.

features.description: While the gearforged remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

features.description: The gearforged has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gearforged makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While the roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

features.name: Grasping Tendrils
features.description: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 15 Strength check against it.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Aquatic Adaptation
features.description: The roper can breathe underwater and has a 10-foot swim speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roper makes four attacks with its tendrils, uses Reel, and makes one attack with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8+4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the roper can't use the same tendril on another target.

actions.name: Reel
actions.description: The roper pulls each creature grappled by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

features.name: Shadow Blend
features.description: While not in sunlight, the black stirge can become invisible as a bonus action. It can end this effect as a bonus action.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge doesn't attack. Instead, the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 4 points of Strength from the target, or the target dies. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the stirge. This replaces the stirge's Blood Drain action.
