languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

features.name: Incessant Babble
features.description: At the start of its turn, the plushies in the swarm spout inane statements—in extremely saccharine tones—such as "You're my best friend!" "I love you!" "Hugs are my favorite!" "It's time for some fun!" and "Let's play!" The incessant babble has no effect on Fey, Constructs, or Undead. Each other creature within 60 feet of the swarm that can hear it must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and becomes frightened of the swarm for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the swarm's incessant babble for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: The plushy swarm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The plushy swarm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The plushy swarm's flensing knives attacks are magical.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny plushy. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Flensing Knives
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) slashing damage, or 10 (3d6) slashing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The nymph can breathe air and water.

features.name: Blinding Beauty
features.description: When a creature that can see the nymph starts its turn within 30 feet of the nymph, the nymph can force it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw if the nymph isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is permanently blinded. Otherwise, a creature that fails its save is blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the nymph until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the nymph in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

features.name: Water Spirit
features.description: While the nymph is in contact with or submerged in a body of water, she ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce her speed or cause her to be restrained. She can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nymph uses Nymph's Gaze. She then makes two Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Nymph's Gaze
actions.description:
The nymph directs her gaze at one creature she can see within 30 feet of her, targeting the creature with one of the following effects: 
Concerned Look. The target regains 10 (3d6) hit points. Once a creature has regained 20 hit points from this stare, it can't regain more hit points from this nymph's Concerned Gaze until it finishes a long rest.
Glare of Nature's Fury. The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Jack Of Strings
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold iron weapons

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The jack of strings has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The jack of strings makes two Mocking Slap attacks.

actions.name: Mocking Slap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Animate Puppet
actions.description: The jack of strings animates up to three wooden puppets it can see within 60 feet of it. This works like the animate objects spell, except the wooden puppet uses the statistics of a Small object, regardless of the puppet's actual size. The jack can have no more than five puppets animated at one time.

actions.name: Puppet Link
actions.description:
One humanoid or beast the jack of strings can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become magically linked to the jack's marionette. This link appears as a barely perceptible string between the jack's marionette and the target. A linked creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the link on a success.

While a target is linked, the jack of strings can use its reaction at the start of the target's turn to control the linked target. The jack of strings can make the target move, manipulate objects, attack, or take other purely physical actions. The jack can't make the target cast spells. While controlled, the target moves awkwardly and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. If the target receives a suicidal command from the jack of strings, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

The jack of strings can have only one target linked at a time. If it links another, the effect on the previous target ends. If a creature dies while linked to the jack's marionette, the creature's body becomes a wooden puppet that resembles the creature.

features.name: Stone Seeker
features.description: The painted king focuses its attacks on any creature carrying one of the painted stones from the Paletree Rise. The king’s goal is to collect the stones, and should they be turned over to it, it gathers them and flees.

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.description: The painted king can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

features.name: Limited Telepathy
features.description: The painted king can speak telepathically with any creature within 60 feet of it that carries a painted stone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The painted king makes three Claw attacks or Paint Splash attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Paint Splash
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The painted king casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): 
    At will: protection from energy
    2/day each: hold person, silence

features.name: Contingent Docility
features.description: If a creature presents an item belonging to Mery to Sable, Sable must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the creature for 1 hour. Sable can repeat the saving throw every 10 minutes, ending the effect on a success. If the effect ends, Sable automatically succeeds on this saving throw for the next 10 minutes.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: Sable has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sable makes one Bite attack and one Shadow Tendril attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength check or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Shadow Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: If the Ticktock Man is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the Ticktock Man instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

features.name: Lightning Absorption
features.description: Whenever the Ticktock Man is subjected to lightning damage, he takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the lightning damage dealt.

features.name: Startling Speed
features.description: The Ticktock Man's movements are so swift that he is almost invisible when in motion. If the Ticktock Man moves at least 10 feet on his turn, attack rolls against him have disadvantage until the start of his next turn, unless the Ticktock Man is incapacitated or restrained.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Ticktock Man makes three Hidden Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Hidden Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

reactions.name: Stolen Time (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.description: If damage is dealt to The Ticktock Man that would kill him, he can attempt to steal time from another creature to avoid death. One creature the Ticktock Man can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and the Ticktock Man regains hp equal to the damage taken. The target is stable and doesn't die if this effect reduces its hp to 0. After 2 rounds, the xiphus takes necrotic damage, and the target regains hp, equal to the original amount borrowed.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The vodyanoi can breathe air and water.

features.name: Water Mastery
features.description: The vodyanoi has advantage on attack rolls if both it and its opponent are in contact with the same body of water. If the opponent and the vodyanoi are both on dry ground, the vodyanoi has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vodyanoi makes two Claws attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13).

name: Weeper in Shadow
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

features.name: Alien Mind
features.description: A creature who attempts to communicate with the weeper must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The weeper has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The weeper makes three attacks, only one of which can be a Stinger attack.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Lashing Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The weeper has two lashing tendrils, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Grasping Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 12), and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pulled to up to 15 feet toward the weeper. It has two grasping tendrils, each of which can grapple only one target. If it is grappling at least one creature with its grasping tendril, the weeper can use this action to pull all creatures grappled in this way up to 30 feet closer to it.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d10+3 slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, range 30/50, one target. Hit 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Rampage
features.description: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gnoll makes two melee attacks with its spear or two ranged attacks with its longbow.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 1d6+2 piercing damage, or 1d8+2 when used with two hands in a melee attack.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 1d8+2 piercing damage, and the target’s speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

name: Pumpkin Jack
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Pumpkin Jack’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. He can cast the following spell innately, requiring no material components:
At will: misty step (when in shadows, dim light, or darkness only)

features.name: Master of the Shadow Roads
features.description: Pumpkin Jack can use the shadow roads to travel to anywhere in Midgard in just 1d3 days. He arrives after dusk, or in a dimly lit or dark area, within 1d6 miles of the desired location. If Pumpkin Jack has been sent after a specific individual and has an item of their clothing or a lock of their hair, he appears within 30 feet of the target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Pumpkin Jack makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is frightened, it takes an additional 10 (3d6) psychic damage from this attack.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature within 60 feet of Pumpkin Jack and aware of him must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Pumpkin Jack’s Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

reactions.name: Relentless Stalker
reactions.description: When an adjacent creature moves away from Pumpkin Jack, he can use his reaction to cast misty step.

source: Wrath of the River King p.38-39

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4 + 2 bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Charge
features.description: If the bull moves at least 30 feet in a straight line toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Hollow Man
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

features.name: Animate Wood Ward
features.description: The Hollow Man can animate one wood ward that it can see and is within 60 feet of it. The wood ward follows simple instructions from the Hollow Man.

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: The Hollow Man is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The Hollow Man has advantage on saving throws against spells or other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The Hollow Man's attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Hollow Man makes two slam attacks or two weapon attacks with Harvester.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Harvester
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Singing Tree
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons

features.name: Thirteen Heads
features.description: The tree begins the adventure with a single mummified head and then adds another for each successful mission the Hollow Man carries out. Instead of targeting the creature, opponents can target the heads. Each head has AC 13 and 5 hit points. Damage to the heads does not reduce the Singing Tree's hit points. Without any heads, the Singing Tree cannot use Sing or Weep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Singing Tree makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and a Medium or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target is also restrained and takes 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns as the Singing Tree constricts it.

actions.name: Weep (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The Singing Tree casts conjure animals, requiring no components. The Singing Tree does not need to maintain concentration for the summoned animals to remain friendly to it.

actions.name: Sing
actions.description: The Singing Tree's song targets a creature within 45 feet that can hear it. The target must make a successful DC 13 Wisdom save or be affected as if by the confusion spell. The target can repeat the save at the end of its turn. The effect ends on a successful save or if the Singing Tree stops singing. While singing, the tree can take other actions. A creature that saves is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space, and vice versa. The swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm cannot regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm is at half its hit points or fewer. The target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 1 poison damage on a failed save.

name: Wood Ward
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: The wood ward is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The wood ward has advantage on saving throws against spells or other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wood ward makes two slam attacks or uses its Horror Gaze.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horror Gaze (1/day)
actions.description: All creatures within a 30-foot cone of the wood ward that it can see make a DC 10 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened of the wood ward for 1 minute. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the saving throw succeeds, the target is immune to this wood ward's gaze for 24 hours.

features.name: Damage Immunity
features.description: A full-grown finger of Derende (AC 15, 40 hit points) is immune to damage from nonmagical weapons.

features.name: Tree Height
features.description: It stands 60 to 70 feet tall, with a 4-foot-thick trunk.

features.name: Sedating Smoke
features.description: When the young giant queen bee enters a sufficiently smoky area for the first time or ends her turn there, she must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be affected as by the slow spell.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Command Bees
features.description: As a bonus action, the Honey Queen can command any number of bees or giant bees telepathically, giving them simple orders. They must be visible to her when she issues the command but will continue to follow orders until they are carried out even if they move out of sight. Awakened or otherwise intelligent bees can resist this effect with a successful DC 15 Charisma saving throw.

features.name: Sedating Smoke
features.description: When the Honey Queen enters a sufficiently smoky area for the first time or ends her turn there, she must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be affected as if by the slow spell.

features.name: Spellcaster
features.description:
The Honey Queen is a 4th-level spellcaster. Her casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): friends, mage hand, minor illusion, poison spray, prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): charm person, entangle, mage armor, sleep
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, scorching ray, suggestion

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save and gaining the poisoned condition until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Spell Immunity
features.description: magic missile

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Duxt wears a brooch of shielding, which gives him resistance to force damage and immunity to damage from the magic missile spell (both included above).

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

features.name: Sedating Smoke
features.description: When the giant bee enters a sufficiently smoky area for the first time or ends its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be affected as if by the slow spell.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Eagehrt is a 6th-level spellcaster whose spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following sorcerer spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, message
1st level (4 slots): charm person, mage armor, magic missile
2nd level (3 slots): alter self, hold person, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): fear, fireball

features.name: Truth Is Red and Flowing (1/day)
features.description: Eagehrt can perform a ritual that reveals the knowledge of a creature's past. The ritual requires at least a pint of the creature's blood, an uncut ruby worth 100 gp or more, and 1 hour to complete. Once it is completed, Eagehrt knows about crucial events in the creature's past and can use that knowledge against the creature; for 24 hours, Eagehrt has advantage on spell attack rolls against the creature, and the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against his spells.

features.name: Visage of the Blood Bound (1/day)
features.description: Eagehrt draws back his hood, revealing a horrific visage of ever-bleeding wounds. Any creature within 60 feet that can see him must make a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of him. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

features.name: Witness
features.description: Ecstatics have advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that affect the mind.

actions.name: Filth-Encrusted Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage; a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw negates the poison damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

name: Iron Teeth of Baba Yaga

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The iron teeth’s spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells innately, requiring only verbal components:
At will: detect magic, mending, ray of frost, true strike
2/day each: grease, magic missile, shield
1/day each: acid arrow, blur, heat metal

actions.name: Pinch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d4 + 4) piercing damage.

source: IRON TEETH OF BABA YAGA p.90

features.name: Forest-Hearted
features.description: While in the Margreve, Chairo has advantage on all Wisdom (Survival) and Intelligence (Nature) checks. She is under the effect of a pass without trace spell at all times; this does not extend to others.

actions.name: Primeval Aspect (1/day)
actions.description: Chairo assumes an aspect of the Margreve. The effect lasts for 1d4 rounds. While she is manifesting the aspect, she has advantage on Charisma checks. Afterward, she must make a successful DC 10 Constitution check or gain one level of exhaustion.

name: Awakened Wolf

features.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
features.description: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The wolf has advantage on attack rolls if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

source: New Creatures and Magic Items p.100-101

name: Green Hussar
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 8

features.name: Agent of the Forest
features.description: While in a forest, the green hussar has advantage on all Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks.

features.name: Woodland Stride
features.description: The green hussar ignores difficult terrain while it is in a forest.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Flowering Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage and the target loses 3 hit points from bleeding at the start of each of its turns for 4 rounds unless it receives magical healing.

source: New Creatures and Magic Items p.101

name: Inushka's Pot
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 6

features.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
features.description: The pot is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the pot must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While it remains motionless, the pot is indistinguishable from a normal cauldron.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boil Over (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The pot is able to expel some of its boiling contents at a target within 15 feet. The target takes 8 (3d4) fire damage, or half that damage on a successful DC 15 Dexterity save. All creatures within 5 feet of the target take 1 fire damage, or no damage on a successful DC 15 Dexterity save.

source: New Creatures and Magic Items p.101-102

name: The Mora

features.name: Sanctuary
features.description: Apathy afflicts all who intend harm against the Mora. Any creature who targets the Mora with an attack or a harmful spell must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This trait doesn't protect the Mora from incidental damage due to area effects that target other creatures.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The Mora is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
3/day: sleep, calm emotions

actions.name: Lullaby
actions.description: One creature that the Mora can see and is within 60 feet is targeted by its lullaby. The target must make a successful DC 14 Constitution save or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

source: New Creatures and Magic Items p.102

name: Mother Babushka

features.name: Subtle Spell (3/day)
features.description: Mother Babushka can choose to cast a spell without the required verbal and/or somatic components.

features.name: Careful Spell (3/day)
features.description: Mother Babushka can choose to allow up-to four creatures to automatically succeed on a saving throw against one of her spells.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Mother Babushka is an 8th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following spells prepared:

If the Would-Be-King of Wolves takes 20 slashing damage in a single attack, a swallowed creature is regurgitated.

features.name: Sin Soak
features.description:
The sin-eater divests its sin-based life force into a victim and dies, and the victim gains immunity to subsequent uses of Sin Soak for 1 hour. The curse affects its victim only during combat. On each of its turns, the victim has a 50 percent chance to act normally; otherwise, the victim acts according to the sin that was infused into that effigy (choose or roll randomly, once per affliction):
Despair—Take a –2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls. 
Envy—Claw at the face of the visible humanoid with the highest Charisma. If the victim does not have a natural claw attack, this attack is a Strength-based unarmed attack that deals 1 piercing damage on a hit.
Gluttony—Make a successful DC 11 Constitution saving throw (the DC increases by +1 for each previous check) or gain 1 level of exhaustion from starvation.
Greed—Attempt to grapple a target and steal the most valuable item it carries.
Pride—Become stunned while contemplating an epiphany about how great you have become.
Sloth—Take no action and become incapacitated.
Wrath—Bite an enemy with animal fury. If the victim does not have a natural bite attack, this attack is a Strength-based unarmed attack that deals 1 piercing damage on a hit.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a successful DC 11 Charisma saving throw or be affected by the effigy's Sin Soak ability.

damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing weapons that are not silver

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The Margreve werewolf can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or a wolf, or back to its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

features.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
features.description: The Margreve werewolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

features.name: Rage (3/day)
features.description: The Margreve werewolf can enter a rage as a bonus action. While raging, it has the following benefits: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, +2 damage on all melee weapon attacks, and advantage on all Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

features.name: Reckless
features.description: At the start of its turn, the Margreve werewolf can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but all attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The werewolf makes two attacks. While in hybrid or wolf form, it can bite as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

actions.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage, or 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

name: AVIGNA
damage_immunities: piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons

features.name: Rapid Caster (4/day)
features.description: Avigna can use her bonus action to cast a cantrip.

features.name: Withered Tresses
features.description: If a rusalka is kept out of water for 24 consecutive hours, its hair and body dry into desiccated swamp weeds and the creature is utterly destroyed.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Avigna’s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: control water, suggestion, tongues, water walk (can be ended freely at will)
1/day: confusion

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Avigna is an 8th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): dancing lights, message, ray of frost
1st level (4 slots): hideous laughter, magic missile, sleep
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, mirror image, scorching ray (deals cold damage)
3rd level (3 slots): fireball (deals cold damage), protection from energy
4th level (2 slots): watery sphere, night terrors (see Heroes Handbook)

actions.name: Breathless Kiss
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: the target is grappled (escape DC 13), and the rusalka draws all the air from the target’s lungs with a kiss. If the rusalka has movement remaining, she drags the grappled creature into deep water, where it begins suffocating.

actions.name: Drowning Hair (1/Day)
actions.description: The rusalka’s long hair tangles around a creature the rusalka has grappled. The creature takes 33 (6d10) necrotic damage, or half damage with a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. In addition, until it escapes the rusalka’s grapple, it is restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks to escape the grapple.

legendary_actions.name: Breathless Kiss
legendary_actions.description: Avigna moves up to half her movement without prompting opportunity attacks and makes a Breathless Kiss attack.

legendary_actions.name: Intrinsic Casting
legendary_actions.description: Avigna uses one of her at-will spells.

name: Baba Ludva
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Baba Ludva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Baba Ludva's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, magic missile, web
2/day: black tentacles, invisibility, plane shift (self only), ray of enfeeblement, sleep
1/day: curse of incompetence (see Heroes Handbook)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Baba Ludva makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws (Hag Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.description: The hag magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium female humanoid, or back into her true form. Her statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.description: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. To do so, the hag must have a heartstone in her possession.

actions.name: Unsettling Presence
actions.description: Each creature that is within 30 feet of Baba Ludva and can see her must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be frightened of her. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once the creature succeeds, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

actions.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day)
actions.description: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane. A protection from evil and good spell cast on the target prevents this contact, as does a magic circle. For as long as the contact persists, the target has dreadful visions. If these visions last for at least 1 hour, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). If this effect reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and if the target was evil, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag. The reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Ensnare (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained by ghostly webbing. While restrained in this way, the target is invisible to all creatures except Baba Ludva. A creature restrained by Ensnare can escape by using an action to make a successful DC 14 Strength check, or the webs can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hp).

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The zmey headling can breathe air and water.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The zmey headling regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. This trait doesn't function if the headling took acid or fire damage since the end of its previous turn. It dies if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (1/day)
features.description: If the zmey headling fails a saving throw, it can count it as a success instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zmey heading makes three bite attacks (one per head) and one claws or tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The zmey headling exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area takes 16 (3d10) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d6 – 1) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8 – 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Antennae
features.description: The Derendian moth abomination has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Assimilation
features.description:
The Derendian moth abomination has six tentacles. Whenever it takes 30 or more damage in a single turn, one of its tentacles is shorn from its body.

Whenever a non-undead creature drops to 0 hit points within 200 feet of the Derendian moth abomination, it can use its reaction to sprout one additional tentacle, up to a maximum of ten. Additional tentacles atrophy after one day.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the Derendian moth abomination fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The Derendian moth abomination's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Unbound
features.description: The Derendian moth abomination's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause it to be paralyzed or restrained.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Derendian moth abomination makes a number of tentacle attacks equal to the number of tentacles it currently possesses, and one beak attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Wings of the Primal Tender (1/day)
actions.description: The Derendian moth abomination teleports to an unoccupied location within 100 feet, leaving a shimmering outline of its wings in its former location. The shimmering wings flap violently before exploding in a rainbow-colored dust cloud covering a 60-foot radius. Any creature caught in the dust cloud must make a successful DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points. Creatures reduced to 0 hit points from this effect regenerate 10 hit points at the beginning of their next three turns.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.description: The abomination makes a Perception check.

legendary_actions.name: Pursue
legendary_actions.description: The abomination moves its flying speed.

legendary_actions.name: Lay Eggs (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The Derendian moth abomination ejects a sticky mass of eggs within 5 feet of itself. At the beginning of the abomination's next turn, the eggs hatch as a swarm of insects that attacks the abomination's enemies.

features.name: Earth Glide
features.description: The gravedirt elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.description: If damage reduces the gravedirt elemental to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a successful save, the gravedirt elemental drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gravedirt elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Acid Sacs
features.description: When the violet takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of the violet must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 2 (1d4) acid damage.

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While the violet remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from other large flowering plants.

features.name: Flesh Sense
features.description: The violet can pinpoint, by scent, the location of flesh-based creatures within 60 feet of it.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 2 (1d4) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The violet has two tendrils strong enough to grapple creatures, each can grapple only one target.  If the acid damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the violet regains 7 (2d6) hp.

name: Colláis
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks
languages: understands Piney and Sylvan but can’t speak

features.name: Impale and Toss
features.description: When the colláis hits a Medium or smaller creature with a gore attack, it can use a bonus action to impale and toss the creature. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 11 (2d10) piercing damage and be flung up to 10 feet away from the colláis in a random direction and knocked prone.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The colláis has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The colláis makes one gore attack and two hooves attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Cry of the Margreve
actions.description: The colláis sounds a dreadful and reverberating call. Each creature within 100 feet of the colláis that can hear the cry must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the colláis’s Cry of the Margreve for the next 24 hours. Forest-dwelling beasts and monstrosities with an Intelligence of 4 or lower automatically succeed or fail on this saving throw, depending on the colláis’s choice.

name: Vine Golem
damage_resistances: bludgeoning and piercing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

features.name: Bound
features.description: The vine golem is psychically bound to its creator and can communicate telepathically with its creator as long as neither is incapacitated. In addition, each knows the distance and direction to the other. The golem and its creator don’t have to be on the same plane of existence to communicate telepathically, but they do have to be on the same plane to know the distance and direction to each other.

name: Lesser Lunarchidna
senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13

features.name: Light Sensitivity
features.description: While in bright light, the lunarchidna has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Shadow Stealth
features.description: While in dim light or darkness, the lunarchidna can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The lunarchidna can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lunarchidna makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Greater Lunarchidna
senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The greater lunarchidna makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 3 slashing damage.

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 14 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success.

name: Lunarchidna
senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The lunarchidna can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the lunarchidna has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Web Walker
features.description: The lunarchidna ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The lunarchidna is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). The lunarchidna has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): minor illusion, mage hand, poison spray, ray of frost
1st level (4 slots): detect magic, magic missile, shield
2nd level (3 slots): alter self, suggestion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lunarchidna makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. If the lunarchidna hits a Medium or smaller target with both attacks on the same turn, the target is restrained by webbing and the lunarchidna uses Wrap Up.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, ranged 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action the restrained target can make a DC 13 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

actions.name: Wrap Up
actions.description: The lunarchidna wraps up a Medium or smaller creature restrained by webbing. The wrapped target is blinded, restrained, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the lunarchidna's turns or take 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The webbing can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 15; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). The lunarchidna can have only one creature wrapped at a time.

name: Transcendent Lunarchidna
senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

features.name: Light Invisibility
features.description: The lunarchidna is invisible while in bright or dim light.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The lunarchidna can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the lunarchidna has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Web Walker
features.description: The lunarchidna ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The lunarchidna is a 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The lunarchidna has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): minor illusion, mage hand, poison spray, ray of frost
1st level (4 slots): color spray, detect magic, magic missile, shield
2nd level (3 slots): alter self, suggestion, web
3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, major image
4th level (2 slots): black tentacles, confusion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The lunarchidna makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, ranged 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is restrained by webbing. As an action the restrained target can make a DC 13 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

actions.name: Lunar Beam (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The lunarchidna flashes a beam of moonlight in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Force of Nature
features.description: When the piney hits with any weapon while within the boundaries of the Margreve, the weapon deals an extra 3 (1d6) force damage (included in the attack).

features.name: Verdant Transformation
features.description:
At the start of each of its turns while it is within the Margreve, the piney can choose one of the following ways for the forest to physically manifest through it:
Oaken Flesh. The piney's Armor Class increases by 2, and it has resistance to bludgeoning damage until the start of its next turn.
Strong Roots. The piney is immune to the prone condition, and it has advantage on ability checks made to grapple until the start of its next turn.
Sun Feaster. The piney regains 3 hit points if it starts its turn in sunlight.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

features.name: Force of Nature
features.description: When the piney rootwalker hits with any weapon while within the boundaries of the Margreve, the weapon deals an extra 7 (2d6) force damage (included in the attack).

features.name: One with the Woods
features.description: While in a forest, the piney rootwalker can’t be tracked. In addition, the piney rootwalker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forest terrain.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The piney rootwalker’s innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
At will: mending, poison spray, resistance  
2/day each: entangle, healing word 
1/day each: locate animals or plants, spike growth

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

features.name: Iron Scent
features.description: The boar can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 60 feet of it.

features.name: Lightning Hide
features.description: A creature that touches the boar or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (2d4) lightning damage.

features.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
features.description: If the boar takes 15 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hp, it is reduced to 1 hp instead.

features.name: Thunder Charge
features.description: If the boar moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 11 (2d10) thunder damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 11 (2d10) lightning damage. In addition, nonmagical metal armor worn by the target is partly devoured by the boar and takes a permanent and cumulative −2 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

actions.name: Lightning Run (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The boar becomes a bolt of living lightning and moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage and is pushed to the closest unoccupied space if it ends its turn inside an object. Each creature in the boar’s path must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Thunder Leap (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The boar moves up to 20 feet, jumping over obstacles in its way. Difficult terrain doesn’t cost it extra movement when it leaps. Each creature within 10 feet of the boar when it leaps and each creature within 10 feet of where it lands must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 16 (3d10) thunder damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the boar. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t pushed.

name: Tree Skinner
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

features.name: False Appearance (Tree Form Only)
features.description: While the skinner remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

features.name: Inhabit Tree
features.description: As a bonus action, the skinner touches a Medium or larger tree that is not a creature and disappears inside it. While inside the tree, the skinner has tremorsense with a radius of 30 feet, has an AC of 15, has a speed of 0, and has vulnerability to fire damage. When the skinner is reduced to 15 hp, the tree dies and the skinner appears within 5 feet of the dead tree or in the nearest unoccupied space. The skinner can exit the tree as a bonus action, appearing within 5 feet of the tree in the nearest unoccupied space, and the tree reverts to being an object. The skinner can inhabit a tree for only 3 days at most before the tree dies, requiring the skinner to seek another vessel.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The skinner has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and become poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Vine Whip (Tree Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). The skinner can grapple up to two creatures at one time.

actions.name: Squeeze (Tree Form Only)
actions.description: The tree skinner makes one vine whip attack against a creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also unable to breathe or cast spells with verbal components until this grapple ends.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The tsuchinoko has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Plant Camouflage
features.description: The tsuchinoko has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

features.name: Standing Leap
features.description: The tsuchinoko's long jump is up to 15 feet and its high jump is up to 5 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tsuchinoko makes two leaping bite attacks. The second attack has disadvantage and must be made against the same target as the first.

actions.name: Leaping Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Hoop Form
actions.description: The tsuchinoko bites its tail, forming a hoop with its body. While in hoop form, the tsuchinoko has a walking speed of 60 feet and can't make leaping bite attacks. The tsuchinoko can end its hoop form as a bonus action.

name: Vallowex
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 14

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The vallowex can breathe air and water.

features.name: Aura of Thirst
features.description: At the start of each of the vallowex's turns, each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check as a gnawing thirst distracts it. For each minute a creature stays in the vallowex's aura, it gains one level of exhaustion from dehydration. A level of exhaustion is removed if the creature uses an action to drink 1 pint of water. A vallowex is immune to its own Aura of Thirst as well as the auras of other vallowexes.

features.name: Underwater Camouflage
features.description: The vallowex has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vallowex makes two attacks: one with its spiked tongue and one with its tail.

actions.name: Spiked Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the vallowex can't use its spiked tongue against another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The vallowex makes one spiked tongue attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the vallowex, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the vallowex's turns. The vallowex can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

name: Wraith Bear
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Detect Ancestors
features.description: The wraith bear knows the direction to its nearest living ancestor on the same plane, but not the ancestor's exact location.

features.name: Draining Regeneration
features.description: The wraith bear regains 10 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp and there are living plants within 5 feet of it. When the wraith bear regains hp, all plant life within 5 feet of it dies, and it can't regain hp from those same plants again.

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.description: The wraith bear can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d8 + 4) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

actions.name: Baleful Roar (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The bear lets out a supernatural roar in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area that can hear the bear must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature is incapacitated for 1 minute. On a success, a creature is frightened until the end of its next turn. An incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: merfolk ghost
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Ethereal Sight
features.description: The ghost can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.description: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6+3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.description: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.description: One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The decapus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tentacles.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the decapus. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (9d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 14 (5d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if the decapus is grappling a creature other than the target or if the decapus is on the ground or floor. The target is also grappled (escape DC 14) unless the decapus is already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

name: Geonid
senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 14

features.name: Boulder Guise
features.description: While fully withdrawn into its shell, the geonid can't see and is indistinguishable from a small boulder.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stone Tell
actions.description: The geonid touches a stone object or surface and knows what types of creatures have been within 10 feet of that stone in the past 24 hours. The geonid can also determine the number of creatures of each type, but not their identities.

name: Topi
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

features.name: Turn Resistance
features.description: The topi has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.description: If damage reduces the topi to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the topi drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Venomous Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the target's next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10 + 3 piercing damage.

features.name: Pounce
features.description: If the deinonychus moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the deinonychus can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The deinonychus makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
